topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text_en: Maya was sketching at the farmers market when a woman with a sleeve of tattoos stopped to look at her prints. Maya recognized the small bird design on the woman's wrist—it was from a painting she had sold months ago. She mentioned it, and the woman smiled, saying she'd loved the original so much she'd had it inked. Maya examined the lines, noticing how the artist had adapted the colors for skin. She asked where the tattoo shop was, then gathered her things, thinking about how the image had traveled beyond her canvas.
text_zh: 玛雅在农贸市场素描时，一位手臂上有纹身的女人停下来看她的画作。玛雅认出了女人手腕上的小鸟图案——那是她几个月前卖掉的一幅画中的。她提起了这件事，女人微笑着，说她太喜欢原作，所以把它纹在了身上。玛雅仔细端详线条，注意到纹身师如何为皮肤调整了颜色。她询问了纹身店的位置，然后收拾好东西，想着这幅图像如何超越了画布，传播到了更远的地方。

topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text_en: Marta was sketching a new piece at her studio table when her phone buzzed. It was a photo from an old friend, showing a forearm with a detailed tattoo. The design was unmistakably hers, a bird-and-branch motif she had painted last spring. She set down her pencil and studied the image, noting the fine lines and shading. Her friend’s message read, “Saw this at a shop downtown.” Marta replied, “That’s my work,” and then went back to her sketch, occasionally glancing at the photo. She wondered who had chosen it and how they had found it.
text_zh: 玛尔塔正在工作室的桌前素描新作品，手机嗡嗡作响。是一位老朋友发来的照片，显示一条前臂上有一个精细的纹身。这个设计无疑是她的，是她去年春天画的一个鸟与树枝的图案。她放下铅笔，仔细研究图像，注意到精细的线条和阴影。朋友的信息写道：“在市中心的一家店看到的。”玛尔塔回复：“那是我的作品。”然后她回到素描中，偶尔瞥一眼照片。她想知道是谁选择了它，以及他们是如何找到它的。

topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text_en: Leo was browsing an online portfolio when he noticed a familiar pattern on a model’s shoulder. He enlarged the image and recognized the swirling waves from a mural he had painted years ago. The tattoo was smaller, but the composition matched exactly. He scrolled through the comments, but no one mentioned the origin. Leo saved the picture to his folder and continued his usual routine, checking his email and preparing for an evening class. He thought about contacting the tattoo artist to ask about the design, but he wasn’t sure what he would say.
text_zh: 利奥正在浏览在线作品集，注意到一个模特肩膀上的熟悉图案。他放大了图像，认出了多年前他画的一幅壁画中的旋转波浪。纹身较小，但构图完全匹配。他滚动评论，但没有人提到来源。利奥将图片保存到文件夹中，继续他的日常，查看电子邮件并为晚上的课程做准备。他考虑联系纹身师询问设计，但不确定该说什么。

topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text_en: Jonas was walking through a flea market when he saw a vendor with a tattoo of a tree whose branches formed a spiral. It was from a series of illustrations he'd done for a local magazine. He stopped and pointed, saying, "I drew that." The vendor laughed and said it was his favorite piece of art. Jonas leaned closer, noting how the ink had faded over time. He asked if he could take a photo of it, and the vendor agreed. Jonas snapped the picture, then moved on to look at some old records.
text_zh: 乔纳斯在逛跳蚤市场时，看到一个摊贩身上有一个树枝形成螺旋的树纹身。这来自他为当地杂志做的一系列插图。他停下来指着说：“那是我画的。”摊贩笑了，说这是她最喜欢的艺术品。乔纳斯靠近些，注意到墨水随时间褪色了。他问是否可以拍张照片，摊贩同意了。乔纳斯拍了照片，然后继续去看一些旧唱片。

topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text_en: Elena was at the beach when she noticed a swimmer with a tattoo of a wave curling into a fish shape. She recognized it as a design from her old portfolio, which she'd posted online years ago. She walked over and introduced herself, explaining the original. The swimmer was interested and asked about the meaning behind it. Elena explained the symbolism, then noticed the tattoo had been placed slightly differently than her sketch. They talked about the artist's interpretation for a few minutes before the swimmer went back into the water.
text_zh: 埃琳娜在海滩上注意到一个游泳者身上有一个波浪卷成鱼形的纹身。她认出这是她旧作品集里的设计，多年前她发布在网上。她走过去自我介绍，解释了原作。游泳者很感兴趣，询问其背后的含义。埃琳娜解释了象征意义，然后注意到纹身的位置与她的草图略有不同。他们谈论了几分钟纹身师的诠释，然后游泳者回到了水中。

topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text_en: During a dinner party, Tom noticed his host's wife had a small tattoo of a crescent moon with a star inside. It was identical to a logo he'd designed for a defunct music festival. He mentioned it casually, and she said she'd gotten it after attending the festival. Tom remembered the design well, the hours he'd spent on the curves. He looked at it on her wrist, seeing how the ink had settled into the skin. He didn't say he was the designer. He just asked if the festival had been good.
text_zh: 在一次晚宴上，汤姆注意到女主人的手腕上有一个小纹身，是新月内含星星的图案。这与他为一个已停办的音乐节设计的标志完全相同。他随口提起，她说是在参加音乐节后纹的。汤姆清楚地记得这个设计，以及他在曲线上花费的时光。他看着手腕上的纹身，看到墨水如何融入皮肤。他没有说自己是设计师，只是问音乐节是否精彩。

topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text_en: Nina was at a bus stop when she saw a man's forearm tattoo depicting a bird in flight, its wings shaped like leaves. It was from a children's book illustration she'd done. She felt a pull to say something, so she told him she liked his tattoo. He thanked her and said it reminded him of his grandmother, who used to read him that book. Nina looked at the details, noticing the artist had kept the original's soft edges. She didn't reveal her connection, just watched as the bus arrived.
text_zh: 尼娜在公交车站看到一个男人的前臂上有一个鸟在飞翔的纹身，翅膀形状像叶子。这来自她做的一本儿童书籍插图。她感到有冲动想说些什么，于是告诉他她喜欢他的纹身。他感谢她，说这让他想起他的祖母，祖母过去常给他读那本书。尼娜看着细节，注意到纹身师保留了原作的柔和边缘。她没有透露她的联系，只是看着公交车到来。

topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text_en: Priya was at a gallery opening, talking with a fellow artist, when she noticed a woman across the room with an intricate tattoo on her wrist. The pattern of interlocking circles was the same as a digital artwork Priya had posted months ago. She excused herself and walked closer, confirming the details. The woman noticed her looking and smiled. Priya said, “That’s a beautiful design.” The woman thanked her and mentioned she had found it online. Priya nodded, then returned to her conversation, thinking about how the image had traveled beyond her screen.
text_zh: 普里亚在画廊开幕式上与一位同行艺术家交谈时，注意到房间对面一位女士手腕上有一个复杂的纹身。相互连接的圆圈图案与普里亚几个月前发布的数字艺术作品相同。她告退后走近，确认了细节。女士注意到她在看，微笑着。普里亚说：“那是一个美丽的设计。”女士感谢她，并提到她是在网上找到的。普里亚点点头，然后回到对话中，想着图像如何超越了屏幕，传播到了更远的地方。

topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text_en: Sam was helping a friend move boxes when he saw a man on the street with a tattoo on his calf. The design was a geometric fox, identical to a logo Sam had created for a local business. He paused for a moment, then continued lifting. Later, he mentioned it to his friend, who shrugged. Sam pulled out his phone and found the original file, comparing it in his mind. He wondered if the man knew the artist who had inked it. He didn’t approach him, just noted the coincidence and finished the move.
text_zh: 萨姆正在帮朋友搬箱子，看到街上一个男人的小腿上有一个纹身。设计是一个几何狐狸，与萨姆为当地一家企业创建的标志完全相同。他停顿了一下，然后继续搬。后来，他向朋友提起，朋友耸耸肩。萨姆掏出手机找到原始文件，在脑海中比较。他想知道那个男人是否认识纹身的艺术家。他没有接近他，只是注意到这个巧合，然后完成了搬家。

topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text_en: Elena was waiting for her coffee when she noticed the barista had a tattoo on her forearm. It was a cluster of stars and a crescent moon, a design Elena had painted for a book cover last year. She pointed at it and said, “I like your tattoo.” The barista smiled and said, “Thanks, I got it from an artist online.” Elena nodded, took her coffee, and sat by the window. She sipped her drink and thought about how her illustration had become part of someone’s daily life, then opened her sketchbook to work.
text_zh: 埃琳娜在等咖啡时，注意到咖啡师的前臂上有一个纹身。那是一簇星星和一个新月，是埃琳娜去年为一本书封面画的图案。她指着说：“我喜欢你的纹身。”咖啡师微笑着说：“谢谢，我是从网上一位艺术家那里得到的。”埃琳娜点点头，拿起咖啡，坐在窗边。她啜饮着饮料，想着她的插图如何成为某人日常生活的一部分，然后打开素描本开始工作。

topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text_en: Jordan was at a park sketching trees when a jogger passed by with a tattoo on his shoulder. The design was a series of overlapping leaves, exactly like a pattern Jordan had drawn for a textile project. Jordan lowered his pencil and watched the jogger continue down the path. He thought about the original drawing, stored in a folder at home. He considered asking the jogger about it, but the man was already far away. Jordan turned back to his sketch and added a few more lines to the trunk.
text_zh: 乔丹在公园里画树时，一个慢跑者经过，肩膀上有个纹身。图案是一系列重叠的叶子，和乔丹为一个纺织项目画的图案一模一样。乔丹放下铅笔，看着慢跑者继续沿着小路跑去。他想起了存放在家里文件夹里的原始画作。他考虑过问那个慢跑者关于纹身的事，但那人已经走远了。乔丹转回他的素描，在树干上加了几笔。

topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text_en: Owen was at a record store, flipping through bins, when he saw a guy with a tattoo of a vinyl record with a crack through it. Owen had designed that image for a band's album cover. He tapped the guy's shoulder and said, "I made that design." The guy pulled his sleeve up more, showing the full tattoo. Owen examined it, seeing how the crack had been made more jagged. They talked about the album, and the guy said it was his favorite. Owen nodded and went back to the records.
text_zh: 欧文在一家唱片店翻看唱片箱时，看到一个家伙手臂上纹着一张有裂缝的唱片。欧文曾为一个乐队的专辑封面设计过这个图案。他拍了拍那人的肩膀说：“那个设计是我做的。”那人把袖子拉得更高，露出完整的纹身。欧文仔细看了看，发现裂缝被改得更锯齿状了。他们聊起了那张专辑，那人说那是他的最爱。欧文点了点头，然后回去继续翻唱片。

topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text_en: At a coffee shop, Rhea saw a woman with a tattoo of a hummingbird hovering over a flower. Rhea recognized it as a piece from her art school portfolio. She sat down nearby and watched the woman type on her laptop. After a while, Rhea said, "Excuse me, I like your tattoo." The woman smiled and said it was from an art piece she'd seen online. Rhea didn't say it was hers. She just looked at the hummingbird's wings, which had been drawn more sharply, then returned to her own work.
text_zh: 在咖啡店，瑞亚看到一个女人手臂上纹着一只蜂鸟悬停在花朵上方。瑞亚认出这是她艺术学校作品集中的一件作品。她坐在附近，看着那个女人在笔记本电脑上打字。过了一会儿，瑞亚说：“打扰一下，我喜欢你的纹身。”那个女人微笑着说是从网上看到的一件艺术品。瑞亚没有说那是她的作品。她只是看着蜂鸟的翅膀，那些翅膀被画得更锐利，然后回到自己的工作中。

topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text_en: During a work break, Alex was scrolling through his phone when a colleague rolled up her sleeve to show a new tattoo. It was a pattern of interlocking triangles that Alex had created for a software app icon. He said, "Hey, that looks like something I designed." She said she'd found it in a design blog. Alex looked at the tattoo, seeing how the triangles had been slightly altered to fit her arm. He didn't push the point, just commented that it was a nice choice, then went back to his screen.
text_zh: 在工作休息时间，亚历克斯正在刷手机，这时一位同事卷起袖子展示一个新纹身。那是亚历克斯为一个软件应用图标设计的连锁三角形图案。他说：“嘿，那看起来像是我设计的东西。”她说她是在一个设计博客上找到的。亚历克斯看着纹身，发现三角形被稍微改动以适应她的手臂。他没有深究，只是评论说这是个不错的选择，然后回到他的屏幕前。

topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text_en: Nina was at a flea market, flipping through old prints, when she saw a vendor with a tattoo on his neck. It was a small abstract shape, a design she had made for a concert poster. She bought a postcard from him and asked, “Where did you get that tattoo?” He said he found it on a design website. Nina nodded and walked on, holding the postcard. She thought about the poster and how it had been used without her knowing. She continued browsing, occasionally glancing at the vendor’s neck.
text_zh: 尼娜在跳蚤市场翻看旧版画时，看到一个摊主脖子上有个纹身。那是一个小小的抽象形状，是她为一张音乐会海报设计的图案。她从他那里买了一张明信片，问道：“你的纹身是在哪里弄的？”他说是在一个设计网站上找到的。尼娜点点头，拿着明信片继续往前走。她想起了那张海报，以及它如何在不知情的情况下被使用。她继续浏览，偶尔瞥一眼摊主的脖子。

topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text_en: At a train station, Ben noticed a woman with a tattoo of a mountain lake with a lone pine tree. It was from a landscape painting Ben had done in an art class. He sat across from her on the platform, and when she glanced up, he said, "I painted that scene." She looked at her arm and then at him, and said she'd bought a print at a gallery. Ben looked at the tattoo, seeing how the lake's reflection had been simplified. He didn't say more, just watched the train approach.
text_zh: 在火车站，本注意到一个女人手臂上纹着一幅山间湖泊和一棵孤松的图案。那是本在艺术课上画的一幅风景画。他坐在站台上她的对面，当她抬头看时，他说：“那幅画是我画的。”她看了看自己的手臂，又看了看他，说她在一家画廊买过一幅印刷品。本看着纹身，发现湖面的倒影被简化了。他没有再多说，只是看着火车驶近。

topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text_en: While at a grocery store, Chloe saw a cashier with a tattoo of a stack of books with a candle on top. It was from an illustration Chloe had done for a library newsletter. She waited until the cashier scanned her items, then said, "I like your tattoo." The cashier said it was from a drawing she'd seen online. Chloe looked at the books, noticing the spines were slightly different colors. She paid, took her bag, and as she walked out, she thought about the original drawing, still in her portfolio.
text_zh: 在杂货店，克洛伊看到一个收银员手臂上纹着一摞书，上面放着一根蜡烛。那是克洛伊为图书馆通讯画的一幅插图。她等到收银员扫描完她的物品，然后说：“我喜欢你的纹身。”收银员说那是她从网上看到的一幅画。克洛伊看着那些书，注意到书脊的颜色略有不同。她付了钱，拿起袋子，走出去时，她想起了那幅仍然放在她作品集中的原始画作。

topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text_en: At a park, Daniel saw a woman jogging with a tattoo of a running wolf on her calf. It was from a logo Daniel had designed for a nature club. He called out, "Hey, that's my design!" The woman stopped and looked at her leg. She said she'd gotten it after joining the club. Daniel walked closer, examining the wolf's fur lines, which had been thickened for the tattoo. He told her he'd designed it a few years ago, and she said she liked the original. He nodded, then continued his walk.
text_zh: 在公园里，丹尼尔看到一个女人在小腿上纹着一只奔跑的狼。那是丹尼尔为一个自然俱乐部设计的标志。他喊道：“嘿，那是我的设计！”那个女人停下来看着自己的腿。她说她加入俱乐部后纹了这个。丹尼尔走近，仔细看着狼的毛发线条，那些线条为了纹身被加粗了。他告诉她那是他几年前设计的，她说她喜欢原版。他点了点头，然后继续散步。

topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text_en: Rosa was at a friend’s barbecue when she saw a guest with a tattoo on her ankle. The design was a series of interlocking triangles, which Rosa had used in a mural for a café. She recognized it immediately and said, “That’s an interesting pattern.” The guest explained she had gotten it from a picture online. Rosa nodded and took a bite of her food. She thought about the mural and how the design had been adapted, then joined a conversation about gardening. The tattoo stayed in her mind for the rest of the afternoon.
text_zh: 罗莎在朋友的烧烤聚会上看到一个客人的脚踝上有个纹身。图案是一系列连锁三角形，罗莎曾在一家咖啡馆的壁画中使用过。她立刻认出来，说：“那是个有趣的图案。”客人解释说她是从一个网上的图片看到的。罗莎点点头，咬了一口食物。她想起了那幅壁画以及图案是如何被改编的，然后加入了关于园艺的谈话。那个纹身在下午剩下的时间里一直留在她的脑海里。

topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text_en: During a yoga class, Adam saw the instructor had a tattoo of a lotus flower with a geometric center. It was from a piece Adam had created for a wellness blog. After class, he approached her and said, "I recognize that lotus." She said she'd found the image while looking for meditation art. Adam looked at the tattoo, seeing how the petals had been simplified for the skin. He mentioned he was the artist, and she seemed interested. They talked briefly about the design, then she went to greet another student.
text_zh: 在瑜伽课上，亚当看到教练身上纹着一朵莲花，中心是几何图案。那是亚当为一个健康博客创作的作品。课后，他走近她说：“我认得那朵莲花。”她说她是在寻找冥想艺术时找到这个图案的。亚当看着纹身，发现花瓣为了适应皮肤被简化了。他提到自己是那位艺术家，她似乎很感兴趣。他们简短地聊了聊这个设计，然后她去迎接另一位学生了。

topic: A family member announces they're converting to a different religion
text_en: Marta was sorting laundry when her brother Daniel came into the kitchen and said he had started attending a mosque with his friend. He explained he had been reading about Islam for a while and felt it made sense to him. Marta folded a towel and asked if their parents knew. Daniel said he planned to tell them on Sunday. Marta nodded and mentioned that his old bedroom still had his Catholic confirmation photo on the dresser. Daniel smiled slightly and said he would take it with him when he moved his things. Marta put the laundry basket aside and started making dinner.
text_zh: 玛尔塔正在整理衣物时，她的兄弟丹尼尔走进厨房，说他开始和朋友一起去清真寺。他解释说他读了一些关于伊斯兰教的书，觉得这对他来说很有意义。玛尔塔叠了一条毛巾，问他们的父母是否知道。丹尼尔说他计划在星期天告诉他们。玛尔塔点点头，提到他的旧卧室的五斗柜上还放着他的天主教坚信礼照片。丹尼尔微微一笑，说他搬东西时会把它带走。玛尔塔把洗衣篮放在一边，开始做晚饭。

topic: A family member announces they're converting to a different religion
text_en: At the breakfast table, Peter's father announced that he would be joining the Buddhist temple downtown. He had been going to meditation sessions for a few weeks. Peter reached for the orange juice and asked what had brought that on. His father said he liked the way the monks talked about suffering and letting go. Peter asked if this meant he would stop going to church with their mother. His father said they had already talked about it. Peter finished his toast and asked if anyone wanted more coffee. His father said yes, and Peter poured it.
text_zh: 早餐桌上，彼得的父亲宣布他将加入市中心的佛教寺庙。他已经去参加冥想课程几个星期了。彼得伸手去拿橙汁，问是什么让他这么做的。他的父亲说他喜欢僧侣们谈论苦难和放下的方式。彼得问这是否意味着他不再和他们的母亲一起去教堂。他的父亲说他们已经谈过这件事了。彼得吃完吐司，问是否有人想再来点咖啡。他的父亲说好，彼得倒了咖啡。

topic: A family member announces they're converting to a different religion
text_en: Leah was watering the plants when her mother called from the porch and said she had decided to convert to Judaism. Leah set down the watering can and walked over. Her mother explained that she had been attending services at a synagogue with a coworker for several months. Leah asked what made her choose this now. Her mother said she had always felt connected to the traditions. Leah asked if she needed help finding a rabbi to talk to. Her mother said she already had one. Leah said she would be glad to go with her sometime.
text_zh: 利亚正在给植物浇水，她母亲从门廊叫她，说她决定皈依犹太教。利亚放下浇水壶，走了过去。她母亲解释说，她几个月来一直和一位同事去犹太教堂参加礼拜。利亚问她为什么现在选择这样做。她母亲说她一直觉得与这些传统有联系。利亚问她是否需要帮助找一位拉比谈谈。她母亲说她已经有一位了。利亚说她很高兴改天陪她一起去。

topic: A family member announces they're converting to a different religion
text_en: Tom came home from work to find his wife, Angela, sitting at the kitchen table with a book about Hinduism. She looked up and said she had been talking to a colleague and decided to explore that faith. Tom put down his briefcase and asked if she was serious. Angela said she was planning to attend a local temple on the weekend. Tom asked what she wanted him to do about their usual Saturday breakfast plans. Angela said they could still have breakfast, just earlier. Tom said that sounded fine and went to change clothes.
text_zh: 汤姆下班回家，发现妻子安吉拉坐在厨房桌旁，拿着一本关于印度教的书。她抬起头说，她一直在和一位同事交谈，决定探索这种信仰。汤姆放下公文包，问她是不是认真的。安吉拉说她计划周末去当地的一座寺庙。汤姆问她，他们通常的周六早餐计划怎么办。安吉拉说他们仍然可以吃早餐，只是要早一点。汤姆说听起来不错，然后去换衣服了。

topic: A family member announces they're converting to a different religion
text_en: Nina's younger sister, Priya, came into her room and announced she had decided to become a Sikh. She had been visiting a gurdwara with her boyfriend. Nina looked up from her laptop and asked if Priya had thought about how their parents would react. Priya said she had already told them and they were okay with it. Nina asked if Priya would wear a turban. Priya said she was still deciding. Nina said she could borrow some of her scarves to practice wrapping. Priya laughed and said that would help.
text_zh: 尼娜的妹妹普里亚走进她的房间，宣布她决定成为锡克教徒。她一直和男朋友去谒师所。尼娜从笔记本电脑上抬起头，问普里亚是否想过父母会有什么反应。普里亚说她已经告诉他们了，他们对此没有意见。尼娜问普里亚是否会戴头巾。普里亚说她还在决定。尼娜说她可以借给她一些围巾练习包裹。普里亚笑了，说那会有帮助。

topic: A family member announces they're converting to a different religion
text_en: When Lena's brother told her he was converting to Judaism, she paused while folding laundry. She asked about the process, and he explained his plans for study and the mikveh. Lena nodded and folded a towel, then mentioned their mother would want to know before the holidays. She suggested he call their mom that evening, since she usually cooked a big dinner. He agreed, and Lena went back to sorting socks. Later, she thought about the change, wondering if the family's usual gatherings would shift, but she didn't dwell on it. She simply added his favorite dish to her shopping list for next week.
text_zh: 当莉娜的兄弟告诉她他要皈依犹太教时，她在叠衣服时停顿了一下。她询问了过程，他解释了他的学习计划和浸礼池的事。莉娜点点头，叠了一条毛巾，然后提到他们的母亲会想在节日前知道这件事。她建议他那天晚上给妈妈打电话，因为她通常会做一顿丰盛的晚餐。他同意了，莉娜继续整理袜子。后来，她想了想这个变化，不知道家人通常的聚会是否会改变，但她没有多想。她只是把他最喜欢的菜加到了下周的购物清单上。

topic: A family member announces they're converting to a different religion
text_en: Marcus set down his coffee cup when his wife said she was converting to Buddhism. He took a sip, then asked what that meant for their Sunday routine. She explained she'd be meditating in the morning and might skip church. Marcus said he could handle making breakfast those days. He noticed the new statue on the shelf and asked where she got it. She said from a shop downtown. He nodded, picked up his keys, and reminded her about the car's oil change. They planned to run errands together, and he walked out the door.
text_zh: 当妻子说她正在皈依佛教时，马库斯放下了咖啡杯。他喝了一口，然后问这对他们的周日惯例意味着什么。她解释说，她早上会冥想，可能不去教堂了。马库斯说那些天他可以负责做早餐。他注意到架子上新雕像，问她从哪里弄来的。她说从市中心的一家商店买的。他点点头，拿起钥匙，提醒她汽车换油的事。他们计划一起去办点事，他走出了门。

topic: A family member announces they're converting to a different religion
text_en: Brian was fixing a loose cabinet hinge when his sister called to say she had converted to Wicca. He put down the screwdriver and asked if she was joking. She said she had been practicing for a while and felt it was right for her. Brian asked if their grandmother knew. His sister said she had told her and their grandmother had given her an old book about herbs. Brian said that sounded like something their grandmother would do. He asked if she needed any help with anything. She said no.
text_zh: 布莱恩正在修理松动的橱柜铰链，这时他姐姐打电话来说她皈依了威卡教。他放下螺丝刀，问她是不是在开玩笑。她说她已经练习了一段时间，觉得这很适合她。布莱恩问他们的祖母是否知道。他姐姐说她已经告诉她了，祖母给了她一本关于草药的老书。布莱恩说这听起来像是祖母会做的事。他问她是否需要任何帮助。她说不用。

topic: A family member announces they're converting to a different religion
text_en: Priya's father announced he was converting to Christianity. She was at the kitchen table, sorting bills. She looked up, then back at the envelopes. She asked if he'd told her mother yet. He said no. Priya suggested he do it soon, because their mother would plan the family gathering around it. She slid a utility bill into a pile and said she'd help him explain the changes to the relatives. He thanked her, and she went back to her task. She thought about the holiday dinner, wondering if the menu would change.
text_zh: 普里亚的父亲宣布他要皈依基督教。她正在厨房桌旁整理账单。她抬起头，然后又看向信封。她问他是否已经告诉了她母亲。他说没有。普里亚建议他尽快告诉她，因为他们的母亲会围绕这件事安排家庭聚会。她把一张水电费账单滑进一堆文件里，说她会帮他向亲戚们解释这些变化。他感谢了她，她又继续做自己的事。她想到了节日晚餐，不知道菜单会不会改变。

topic: A family member announces they're converting to a different religion
text_en: At the dinner table, my brother set down his fork and said he had been attending a mosque with a coworker for several months and planned to formally convert. My mother paused mid-bite, then asked if he had thought about how this would affect the holidays. He said he had, and that he hoped we would still gather, just with adjustments. My father nodded slowly and mentioned he had read about Ramadan last year. I passed the salad bowl to my sister, who asked what kind of food we might try for Eid. We finished eating, and my brother offered to do the dishes.
text_zh: 晚餐桌上，我兄弟放下叉子，说他几个月来一直和一位同事去清真寺，计划正式皈依。我母亲在咀嚼中停顿了一下，然后问他是否想过这会如何影响节日。他说他想过了，他希望我们仍然能聚在一起，只是需要做些调整。我父亲慢慢地点了点头，提到他去年读过关于斋月的文章。我把沙拉碗递给我妹妹，她问我们开斋节可以尝试什么食物。我们吃完了饭，我兄弟主动提出洗碗。

topic: A family member announces they're converting to a different religion
text_en: My cousin announced over the phone that she had joined a Buddhist community and would be taking refuge vows next month. I was sitting at the kitchen counter, sorting mail, and I paused to listen. She explained that she had been meditating for a year and felt it was the right path. I asked if she would still come to the family reunion, and she said yes, though she might skip the barbecue. I told her about a nearby temple that offered Sunday talks. She said she knew it. We talked for a while about her work schedule, then I wished her well and hung up.
text_zh: 我的表妹在电话里宣布她加入了一个佛教团体，下个月将受皈依戒。我当时正坐在厨房台前整理邮件，停下来听她说话。她解释说她已经冥想了一年，觉得这是正确的道路。我问她是否还会来家庭聚会，她说会来，尽管她可能会跳过烧烤。我告诉她附近有一座寺庙提供周日讲座。她说她知道。我们聊了一会儿她的工作安排，然后我祝她一切顺利，挂了电话。

topic: A family member announces they're converting to a different religion
text_en: Jenna was packing her lunch for work when her mother called and said she had decided to become a Muslim. Jenna put the sandwich in the bag and asked if she had been studying with someone. Her mother said she had been reading the Quran and talking to a woman at the library. Jenna asked if she would start wearing a hijab. Her mother said she was thinking about it. Jenna said she could help her pick out some scarves if she wanted. Her mother said that would be nice.
text_zh: 珍娜正在为上班打包午餐，她妈妈打电话来说她决定成为穆斯林。珍娜把三明治放进袋子里，问她是否一直在跟某人学习。她妈妈说她在读《古兰经》，并和图书馆的一位女士交谈。珍娜问她是否会开始戴头巾。她妈妈说她在考虑。珍娜说如果她愿意，她可以帮她挑选一些围巾。她妈妈说那太好了。

topic: A family member announces they're converting to a different religion
text_en: Elena's mother announced she was converting to Sikhism. Elena looked up from her laptop, where she was booking a hotel for a family visit. She asked about the changes, such as dress and prayer times. Her mother explained, and Elena added some notes to her calendar. She asked if her mother would need a separate meal at the family restaurant. Her mother said she'd eat vegetarian. Elena updated the reservation accordingly and mentioned that her father might want to know. Her mother said she'd call him later. Elena finished the booking.
text_zh: 埃琳娜的母亲宣布她将皈依锡克教。埃琳娜从笔记本电脑上抬起头，她正在为家庭访问预订酒店。她询问了变化，比如着装和祈祷时间。她母亲解释了，埃琳娜在日历上添加了一些备注。她问母亲是否需要在家庭餐厅单独用餐。她母亲说她会吃素。埃琳娜相应地更新了预订，并提到她父亲可能想知道。她母亲说她会稍后给他打电话。埃琳娜完成了预订。

topic: A family member announces they're converting to a different religion
text_en: Omar's older brother came to his apartment and said he was converting to Hinduism. Omar was watering a plant on the windowsill. He set down the watering can and asked what that meant for their family's usual celebrations. His brother mentioned he'd be following a vegetarian diet and attending temple. Omar said he'd keep that in mind for the weekend barbecue. He asked if his brother wanted a special dish made, and his brother suggested a lentil curry. Omar wrote it down on a sticky note and stuck it to the fridge.
text_zh: 奥马尔的哥哥来到他的公寓，说他将皈依印度教。奥马尔正在给窗台上的植物浇水。他放下浇水壶，问这对他们家庭通常的庆祝活动意味着什么。他哥哥提到他会遵循素食饮食并去寺庙。奥马尔说他会为周末烧烤记住这一点。他问哥哥是否想要做一道特别的菜，哥哥建议做扁豆咖喱。奥马尔把它写在便利贴上，贴在了冰箱上。

topic: A family member announces they're converting to a different religion
text_en: When her son told her he was converting to Mormonism, Claire looked at him from the kitchen stove. She stirred the soup and asked if he'd thought it through. He said he had, and he'd been meeting with missionaries for months. Claire asked if he had any questions about family history, since he'd be doing genealogy. He said he'd like to learn more. She offered to show him the family records in the old trunk. They agreed to look through them together on the weekend. She turned back to the stove.
text_zh: 当儿子告诉她他将皈依摩门教时，克莱尔从厨房的炉子旁看着他。她搅拌着汤，问他是否想清楚了。他说他想清楚了，他已经和传教士会面几个月了。克莱尔问他是否对家族历史有任何疑问，因为他将要做家谱研究。他说他想了解更多。她提出给他看旧箱子里的家族记录。他们同意周末一起翻阅。她转身回到炉子旁。

topic: A family member announces they're converting to a different religion
text_en: Rita's husband said he was converting to Zoroastrianism. She was folding a blanket on the couch. She paused, then continued folding. She asked how long he'd been thinking about it. He said a while, and he'd been reading about it. Rita asked if he'd want to raise their daughter in that faith. He said he'd like to explain it to her when she was older. Rita put the blanket aside and said they could talk more after dinner. She got up to set the table, and they ate as usual.
text_zh: 丽塔的丈夫说他将皈依琐罗亚斯德教。她正在沙发上叠毯子。她停顿了一下，然后继续叠。她问他考虑这件事多久了。他说有一段时间了，他一直在阅读相关内容。丽塔问他是否想以这种信仰抚养他们的女儿。他说他想等她大一点再向她解释。丽塔把毯子放在一边，说他们可以在晚饭后再谈。她起身摆好桌子，他们像往常一样吃饭。

topic: A family member announces they're converting to a different religion
text_en: When her aunt said she was converting to the Bahá'í Faith, Nadia looked up from her book. She'd been reading about gardening. She asked what that involved, and her aunt mentioned community gatherings and the goal of unity. Nadia nodded and said it sounded interesting. She asked if her aunt would still come to family birthdays. Her aunt said yes, and they'd be there. Nadia marked her page and asked if her aunt wanted to join her for a walk. They went outside together, and the conversation shifted to the weather.
text_zh: 当她的姑姑说她将皈依巴哈伊信仰时，纳迪亚从书上抬起头。她一直在读关于园艺的书。她问那涉及什么，姑姑提到了社区聚会和团结的目标。纳迪亚点点头，说听起来很有趣。她问姑姑是否还会来参加家庭生日聚会。姑姑说是的，他们会来。纳迪亚标记了她的书页，问姑姑是否想和她一起去散步。他们一起出去了，话题转向了天气。

topic: A family member announces they're converting to a different religion
text_en: Carlos's cousin told him over the phone that she was converting to the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. Carlos was in his garage, sorting tools. He held the phone between his ear and shoulder, sorting screws. He asked if she'd told her parents. She said not yet. Carlos said they might be taken aback, but she should tell them soon. He said he'd be there if she needed support. She thanked him. He asked if she wanted to get lunch next week, and she agreed. He hung up and went back to the toolbox.
text_zh: 卡洛斯的表妹在电话里告诉他，她将皈依耶稣基督后期圣徒教会。卡洛斯在车库里整理工具。他用耳朵和肩膀夹着电话，整理螺丝。他问她是否告诉了她的父母。她说还没有。卡洛斯说他们可能会感到惊讶，但她应该尽快告诉他们。他说如果需要支持，他会在那里。她感谢了他。他问她下周是否想吃午饭，她同意了。他挂了电话，回到工具箱旁。

topic: A family member announces they're converting to a different religion
text_en: Maya set the serving bowl on the table and looked at her brother, who was helping his son into a chair. He waited until everyone was seated before he cleared his throat and told them he had started attending a different church with his wife. Their mother paused in spooning out the rice and asked a few questions about the services. Maya passed the bread basket and listened to the details, noting how her brother's voice had a steadier tone than usual. After dinner, she helped clear the plates while the conversation moved to other topics. His family left at their usual time.
text_zh: 玛雅把上菜碗放在桌子上，看着她的哥哥，他正在帮他的儿子坐到椅子上。他等到大家都坐好，才清了清嗓子，告诉他们他和妻子开始去另一个教堂了。他们的母亲在舀米饭时停顿了一下，问了一些关于礼拜的问题。玛雅递过面包篮，听着细节，注意到哥哥的声音比平时更平稳。晚饭后，她帮忙收拾盘子，而谈话转向了其他话题。他的家人像往常一样离开了。

topic: A family member announces they're converting to a different religion
text_en: When his sister told him she was converting to the Amish community, Jake was repairing a bicycle tire in the shed. He looked up and wiped his hands on a rag. He asked if she'd really considered the lifestyle change. She said she had, and she'd been visiting a nearby community. Jake asked about her job and phone use. She said she was prepared to give them up. Jake nodded and offered to help sell some of her belongings. They planned a garage sale for Saturday. He went back to the tire.
text_zh: 当他的妹妹告诉他她将皈依阿米什社区时，杰克正在棚子里修理自行车轮胎。他抬起头，用抹布擦了擦手。他问她是否真的考虑过这种生活方式的改变。她说她考虑过了，她一直在拜访附近的社区。杰克问起她的工作和手机使用情况。她说她准备好放弃这些。杰克点点头，提出帮她卖掉一些物品。他们计划在周六举行庭院旧货出售。他回到轮胎旁。

topic: Someone's childhood imaginary friend appears in their niece's drawings
text_en: When Maya visited her brother's house, her niece Clara showed her a drawing of a tall figure with a crooked hat and a long scarf. Maya paused, recognizing the exact details from her own childhood. She used to draw that same figure in the margins of her schoolbooks. She asked Clara where she got the idea. Clara shrugged and said she just made it up. Maya looked at the drawing again, then helped Clara tape it to the fridge. She didn't mention that the figure had a name, a name she hadn't thought about in years.
text_zh: 当玛雅去她哥哥家时，她的侄女克拉拉给她看了一幅画，画中是一个戴着歪帽子、围着长围巾的高个子人物。玛雅停顿了一下，认出了自己童年时的确切细节。她过去常常在课本的页边空白处画这个人物。她问克拉拉这个想法是从哪里来的。克拉拉耸耸肩，说她只是编的。玛雅又看了看画，然后帮克拉拉把它用胶带贴在冰箱上。她没有提到这个人物有个名字，一个她多年未想起的名字。

topic: Someone's childhood imaginary friend appears in their niece's drawings
text_en: Elena flipped through the pages of drawings her niece had brought over. Most showed houses with big windows, trees with round canopies, and a smiling sun. Then she stopped at a figure with a tall hat and a crooked umbrella, standing beside a small dog. Elena remembered inventing that character years ago, when she played alone in her grandmother's backyard. She had almost forgotten its name until now. She set the drawing down and looked at it again. Her niece asked if she liked it. Elena said it was a nice drawing and helped her pick out colors for the next one.
text_zh: 埃琳娜翻看着侄女带来的画作。大多数画的是有大窗户的房子、圆形树冠的树和微笑的太阳。然后她停在一个戴着高帽子、拿着弯伞、旁边站着一只小狗的人物画前。埃琳娜记得多年前她在祖母的后院独自玩耍时发明了这个角色。直到现在她几乎忘了它的名字。她放下画，又看了看。侄女问她是否喜欢。埃琳娜说这是一幅不错的画，并帮她为下一幅画挑选颜色。

topic: Someone's childhood imaginary friend appears in their niece's drawings
text_en: Maya noticed the drawing pinned to the refrigerator when she came in from work. Her niece had drawn a person with long braids and a patch over one eye, holding a lantern. Maya recognized the figure immediately from the stories she used to tell herself as a child. She had never mentioned it to anyone. She asked her sister where the idea came from, and her sister said the girl had just started drawing it last week. Maya looked at the picture for a while, then went to help with dinner. She didn't bring it up again.
text_zh: 玛雅下班回来时注意到冰箱上钉着那幅画。她的侄女画了一个扎着长辫子、戴着眼罩、提着灯笼的人。玛雅立刻认出这个人物，那是她小时候给自己讲的故事里的。她从未向任何人提起过。她问姐姐这个想法是从哪里来的，姐姐说女孩上周才开始画这个。玛雅看了一会儿画，然后去帮忙做晚饭。她没有再提起这件事。

topic: Someone's childhood imaginary friend appears in their niece's drawings
text_en: The crayon drawing showed a small creature with wings and a striped scarf. Lucas stared at it longer than he meant to. That was exactly how he had pictured his imaginary friend when he was young, though he had never described it to anyone. His niece handed him the paper and said it was her favorite thing to draw. Lucas thanked her and put it on the shelf with her other artwork. Later he noticed the drawing again while passing by, but he didn't mention the resemblance to anyone. He just continued with his evening chores.
text_zh: 蜡笔画上画着一个长着翅膀、围着条纹围巾的小生物。卢卡斯盯着它看的时间比他预想的要长。那正是他小时候想象中的朋友的样子，尽管他从未向任何人描述过。侄女把纸递给他，说这是她最喜欢画的东西。卢卡斯谢过她，把它和她的其他作品一起放在架子上。后来他路过时又注意到了那幅画，但没有向任何人提起相似之处。他只是继续做晚上的家务。

topic: Someone's childhood imaginary friend appears in their niece's drawings
text_en: Priya sat on the floor with her niece, who was drawing on a big sheet of paper. The girl carefully colored a figure with round glasses and a cape. Priya remembered inventing a character like that in elementary school, one who lived in the closet and gave advice about math homework. She had not thought about it in years. She watched her niece add a hat and a pair of boots. Priya asked what the person's name was. The girl said it was just a person. Priya nodded and helped find a missing crayon.
text_zh: 普里亚和侄女一起坐在地板上，侄女正在一张大纸上画画。女孩仔细地给一个戴着圆眼镜、披着斗篷的人物上色。普里亚记得小学时发明过这样一个角色，他住在衣柜里，给数学作业提供建议。她已经多年没有想起过它了。她看着侄女给人物加上帽子和靴子。普里亚问这个人叫什么名字。女孩说只是一个人。普里亚点点头，帮忙找了一支丢失的蜡笔。

topic: Someone's childhood imaginary friend appears in their niece's drawings
text_en: When Rachel picked up her niece from school, the girl immediately showed her a drawing. It showed a tall figure with a long coat and a key hanging from its neck. Rachel recognized the image from her childhood, when she had imagined a guardian who unlocked doors in her dreams. She had never drawn it herself. She told her niece it was a good picture and asked about the rest of her day. On the way home, she kept the drawing in her lap and occasionally glanced at it while driving.
text_zh: 瑞秋从学校接侄女时，女孩立刻给她看了一幅画。画上是一个穿着长外套、脖子上挂着钥匙的高个子人物。瑞秋认出了这个形象，那是她童年时想象的守护者，在梦中打开门。她自己从未画过。她告诉侄女这是一幅好画，并问她当天过得怎么样。回家的路上，她把画放在腿上，开车时偶尔瞥一眼。

topic: Someone's childhood imaginary friend appears in their niece's drawings
text_en: Daniel's niece had left a stack of drawings on the coffee table. He flipped through them and saw a figure with a wide-brimmed hat and a walking stick. He remembered creating that character during a long summer when he was home alone. The figure was supposed to be a traveler who visited different rooms. Daniel set the drawing aside and continued looking at the others. When his niece came back, he told her the traveler drawing was interesting. She said she liked drawing it because it was easy. He agreed and handed her a fresh sheet of paper.
text_zh: 丹尼尔的侄女把一叠画留在了咖啡桌上。他翻看着，看到了一个戴着宽边帽、拄着拐杖的人物。他记得在独自在家的漫长夏天里创造了这个角色。这个人物应该是一个拜访不同房间的旅行者。丹尼尔把画放在一边，继续看其他的。侄女回来后，他告诉她旅行者的画很有趣。她说她喜欢画它，因为很容易。他同意并递给她一张新纸。

topic: Someone's childhood imaginary friend appears in their niece's drawings
text_en: Sofia's niece ran into the kitchen holding a piece of paper. On it was a person with a long scarf and a bird perched on the shoulder. Sofia paused because that matched the imaginary friend she had described to her brother when they were children. Her brother was now the girl's father, but he rarely talked about those days. Sofia asked her niece who the person was. The girl said it was someone who lived in the clouds. Sofia smiled briefly and then helped her pour juice into a cup.
text_zh: 索菲亚的侄女跑进厨房，手里拿着一张纸。上面画着一个人，围着长围巾，肩上停着一只鸟。索菲亚停顿了一下，因为这和她小时候向哥哥描述的想象中的朋友相符。她的哥哥现在是女孩的父亲，但他很少谈论那些日子。索菲亚问侄女这个人是谁。女孩说是一个住在云里的人。索菲亚短暂地笑了笑，然后帮她往杯子里倒果汁。

topic: Someone's childhood imaginary friend appears in their niece's drawings
text_en: The drawing on the table showed a figure with a pointed hood and a small lantern. It reminded Nathan of the imaginary companion he had invented to keep him company during walks to the bus stop. He had given the figure a name and a habit of humming. He asked his niece where she had seen such a person. She said she made it up. Nathan looked at the drawing for a moment, then folded it carefully and placed it in his pocket. He later put it on his desk at home.
text_zh: 桌上的画上画着一个戴着尖头兜帽、提着小灯笼的人物。这让内森想起了他发明的想象中的伙伴，在步行去公交车站的路上陪伴他。他给这个人物起了名字，还有哼歌的习惯。他问侄女在哪里见过这样的人。她说她编的。内森看了一会儿画，然后小心地折叠起来放进口袋。后来他把它放在家里的书桌上。

topic: Someone's childhood imaginary friend appears in their niece's drawings
text_en: Ava's niece showed her a drawing of a woman with a tall crown and a cat beside her. Ava recognized the exact outfit and cat from the stories she used to tell herself before bed. She had never shared those stories with anyone. She asked her niece if she had seen a picture like that somewhere. The girl said no, she just liked drawing crowns. Ava looked at the picture again and then helped her niece glue it into a scrapbook. They spent the rest of the afternoon cutting out shapes.
text_zh: 艾娃的侄女给她看了一幅画，画中是一个戴着高冠、旁边有只猫的女人。艾娃认出了那套衣服和猫，正是她睡前给自己讲的故事里的。她从未与任何人分享过那些故事。她问侄女是否在什么地方见过这样的画。女孩说没有，她只是喜欢画王冠。艾娃又看了看画，然后帮侄女把它粘进剪贴簿。她们整个下午都在剪形状。

topic: Someone's childhood imaginary friend appears in their niece's drawings
text_en: When Liam came to pick up his niece, she was sitting at the table with crayons. She held up a drawing of a robot with a flower on its head. Liam remembered imagining a robot friend like that when he was young, one who helped him find lost toys. He had never told anyone about it. He said it was a nice robot and asked if it had a name. She said it was just a robot. He nodded and gathered her things. He left the drawing on the table when they went out.
text_zh: 当利亚姆来接他的侄女时，她正坐在桌边玩蜡笔。她举起一幅画，画的是一个头上戴着花的机器人。利亚姆想起自己小时候也曾想象过这样一个机器人朋友，一个帮他找到丢失玩具的朋友。他从未告诉过任何人这件事。他说这是个不错的机器人，并问它有没有名字。她说它只是个机器人。他点点头，收拾好她的东西。他们出门时，他把画留在了桌上。

topic: Someone's childhood imaginary friend appears in their niece's drawings
text_en: Hannah found the drawing under a pile of papers. It showed a small person with a big backpack and a map. She remembered inventing an explorer friend when she was a child, someone who went on adventures in the backyard. She had almost forgotten the details until now. Her niece came over and said she had drawn it at school. Hannah asked what the explorer was doing. The girl said looking for treasure. Hannah looked at the map in the drawing and then put the paper back with the others.
text_zh: 汉娜在一堆纸下面发现了那幅画。画上是一个背着大背包、拿着地图的小人。她想起自己小时候曾虚构过一个探险家朋友，一个在后院冒险的角色。她几乎忘了那些细节，直到现在。她的侄女走过来，说这是她在学校画的。汉娜问那个探险家在做什么。女孩说在找宝藏。汉娜看了看画中的地图，然后把纸放回了其他纸堆里。

topic: Someone's childhood imaginary friend appears in their niece's drawings
text_en: The picture showed a figure with a wide smile and a top hat, holding a balloon. It matched the imaginary friend Ethan had created during a rainy week when he was young. He had given the friend a voice and a habit of telling jokes. His niece had drawn it without any prompting. Ethan asked her about the balloon, and she said it was for a party. He looked at the drawing for a moment, then helped her hang it on the wall with tape. They went outside to play afterwards.
text_zh: 画上是一个咧嘴大笑、戴着高顶礼帽、拿着气球的人物。这正符合伊桑小时候在一个多雨的星期里创造的想象中的朋友。他曾给这个朋友赋予了一个声音和讲笑话的习惯。他的侄女在没有提示的情况下画了这幅画。伊桑问她气球的事，她说那是为派对准备的。他看了一会儿画，然后帮她用胶带把画挂在了墙上。之后他们到外面去玩了。

topic: Someone's childhood imaginary friend appears in their niece's drawings
text_en: Maya flipped through the stack of drawings her niece had brought over. Most were the usual bright suns and lopsided houses, but one caught her attention. A tall figure with a crooked hat stood beside a small girl, both holding hands. The hat was unmistakable. Maya had drawn the same character for years as a child, a friend she had invented to accompany her on long car rides. She set the drawing down and picked up another, finding the same figure in a garden. Her sister noticed her pause and asked what was wrong. Maya just shook her head and folded the drawings neatly, placing them back on the table.
text_zh: 玛雅翻看着侄女带来的一叠画。大部分是常见的明亮太阳和歪歪扭扭的房子，但有一幅引起了她的注意。一个戴着歪帽子、身材高大的人物站在一个小女孩旁边，两人手牵着手。那顶帽子是无可置疑的。玛雅小时候多年画过同一个角色，那是她虚构的一个朋友，用来陪伴她度过漫长的乘车旅程。她放下那幅画，又拿起另一幅，发现同一个角色出现在一个花园里。她姐姐注意到她停顿了一下，问她怎么了。玛雅只是摇了摇头，把画整齐地叠好，放回了桌上。

topic: Someone's childhood imaginary friend appears in their niece's drawings
text_en: Elena helped her niece sort through a box of crayons, watching as the girl carefully colored a large figure with a striped scarf. The shape was familiar, too familiar. Elena remembered her own childhood sketches, the same scarf, the same wide eyes. She had called the figure Mr. Wiggles, a companion for rainy afternoons. She asked her niece where she had seen such a character. The girl shrugged, saying she just made it up. Elena studied the drawing again, noting the slightly uneven stripes and the way the figure’s arms were raised, just like her old ones. She handed the paper back and returned to sorting crayons.
text_zh: 埃琳娜帮侄女整理一盒蜡笔，看着女孩仔细地给一个戴着条纹围巾的大人物上色。这个形状很熟悉，太熟悉了。埃琳娜想起自己童年的素描，同样的围巾，同样的大眼睛。她曾把这个人物叫做威格斯先生，一个陪伴她度过下雨午后的伙伴。她问侄女在哪里见过这样的角色。女孩耸耸肩，说她只是编的。埃琳娜又仔细看了看画，注意到略微不均匀的条纹和人物举起手臂的方式，和她以前的画一模一样。她把纸递回去，继续整理蜡笔。

topic: Someone's childhood imaginary friend appears in their niece's drawings
text_en: Lena’s niece had left a folder of drawings on the kitchen counter. Lena glanced through them while waiting for water to boil. One page showed a figure with a long coat and a round button nose, standing beside a small house. Lena paused. That was Barnaby, the friend she had invented during a lonely summer. She had never mentioned him to anyone, not even her sister. She looked closer at the drawing, noticing the same gentle smile she used to give him. Her niece had written a name underneath in shaky letters: Barnaby. Lena set the paper down, turned off the stove, and placed the folder on the shelf without saying anything.
text_zh: 莉娜的侄女把一文件夹的画留在了厨房台面上。莉娜在等水烧开时翻了翻。有一页画的是一个穿着长外套、长着圆纽扣鼻子的人物，站在一座小房子旁边。莉娜停住了。那是巴纳比，她在孤独的夏天虚构的朋友。她从未向任何人提起过他，甚至没跟她姐姐提过。她凑近看那幅画，注意到她过去常赋予他的那种温和的微笑。她的侄女在下面用歪歪扭扭的字写了一个名字：巴纳比。莉娜放下纸，关掉炉子，把文件夹放在架子上，什么也没说。

topic: Someone's childhood imaginary friend appears in their niece's drawings
text_en: The drawing showed a tall figure with a long coat and a hat with a feather. It reminded Caleb of the imaginary friend he had created during a winter when he stayed indoors. The friend was supposed to be a traveler who told stories about faraway places. He had never shared this with his family. His niece handed him the drawing and said it was a person from her dreams. Caleb looked at it for a moment, then said it was a fine drawing. He put it on the shelf with her other artwork.
text_zh: 画上是一个穿着长外套、戴着插有羽毛的帽子、身材高大的人物。这让凯勒布想起他在一个待在室内的冬天创造的想象中的朋友。那个朋友应该是一个旅行者，讲述遥远地方的故事。他从未与家人分享过这件事。他的侄女把画递给他，说这是她梦中的人。凯勒布看了一会儿画，然后说这是一幅不错的画。他把它和她的其他作品一起放在了架子上。

topic: Someone's childhood imaginary friend appears in their niece's drawings
text_en: Nora's niece was drawing at the kitchen table. She held up a picture of a person with a big hat and a bird on the shoulder. Nora recognized the image from her own childhood, when she had imagined a companion who could talk to animals. She had never told anyone about that. She asked her niece if the bird was talking. The girl said yes, it was telling a secret. Nora smiled slightly and then asked what the secret was. The girl whispered something in her ear. Nora nodded and continued watching her draw.
text_zh: 诺拉的侄女正在厨房桌边画画。她举起一幅画，画上是一个戴着大帽子、肩上站着一只鸟的人物。诺拉认出了这个形象，来自她自己的童年，那时她想象过一个能与动物交谈的伙伴。她从未告诉过任何人这件事。她问侄女那只鸟是不是在说话。女孩说是的，它在讲一个秘密。诺拉微微笑了笑，然后问秘密是什么。女孩在她耳边低声说了些什么。诺拉点点头，继续看着她画画。

topic: Someone's childhood imaginary friend appears in their niece's drawings
text_en: When Julia saw the drawing, she stopped for a second. It showed a figure with a striped scarf and a small boat. That was exactly the imaginary friend she had invented during a summer at the beach. She had given the friend a name and a habit of collecting shells. Her niece said she had drawn it because boats were fun. Julia looked at the picture and then asked if she could keep it. The girl said yes. Julia placed it in her bag and they went to the park together.
text_zh: 当朱莉娅看到那幅画时，她停了一秒钟。画上是一个戴着条纹围巾、旁边有一只小船的人物。那正是她在海边度过的夏天虚构的想象中的朋友。她给这个朋友取了一个名字，并赋予它收集贝壳的习惯。她的侄女说她画这个是因为船很有趣。朱莉娅看了看画，然后问她是否可以留着它。女孩说可以。朱莉娅把它放进包里，然后她们一起去了公园。

topic: Someone's childhood imaginary friend appears in their niece's drawings
text_en: The drawing on the table showed a person with a long cape and a lantern. It matched the imaginary friend Max had created when he was young, one who helped him find his way in the dark. He had never mentioned it to his family. His niece had drawn it without any explanation. Max asked her what the person was doing. She said looking for something. Max looked at the lantern and then helped her draw a path on the ground. They spent the rest of the afternoon drawing together.
text_zh: 桌上的画显示了一个披着长斗篷、拿着灯笼的人物。这符合马克斯小时候创造的想象中的朋友，一个帮助他在黑暗中找到路的朋友。他从未向家人提起过这件事。他的侄女画了这幅画，没有任何解释。马克斯问她那个人在做什么。她说在找东西。马克斯看了看灯笼，然后帮她在地上画了一条路。他们一起度过了下午剩下的时间画画。

topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text_en: Marta noticed the stakes along the property line when she got home from work. Her neighbor had placed them in a neat row, with string connecting them. She stood at the kitchen window, sipping water, watching him measure with a tape. He waved, and she waved back. Later, she mentioned it to her brother on the phone. He asked if she had checked the survey map. She had not. That evening, she walked along the row, stepping carefully around the stakes. The fence would block the view of his backyard, but it would also give him privacy. She figured she would ask him about the height tomorrow.
text_zh: 玛尔塔下班回到家，注意到了地界线上立着的木桩。邻居把它们排成整齐的一行，用绳子连了起来。她站在厨房窗边，喝着水，看着他拿卷尺测量。他挥了挥手，她也挥手回应。后来，她在电话里向哥哥提起了这件事。他问她是否查过地界测量图。她没有。那天傍晚，她沿着那排木桩走着，小心地绕过它们。那道栅栏会挡住她看邻居后院的视线，但也会给他带来隐私。她想，明天该问问他栅栏的高度。

topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text_en: The surveyor’s flags appeared in the side yard early Tuesday. Leo saw them from the kitchen window while making coffee. At dusk, his neighbor called over the fence to say he was planning a wooden fence and wanted to share the cost. Leo mentioned the drainage swale that ran near the boundary. The neighbor said the fence could be set back a foot. Leo replied that he’d look at the property map and get back to him. He finished his coffee, then went out to check the flags. The neighbor had already gone inside.
text_zh: 周二一早，测量员的旗子出现在侧院里。利奥在做咖啡时从厨房窗户看到了它们。黄昏时，邻居隔着栅栏喊他，说自己打算建一道木栅栏，想分摊费用。利奥提到了靠近地界的那条排水沟。邻居说栅栏可以后退一英尺。利奥回答说他会看看地界图，然后给他答复。他喝完咖啡，出去查看那些旗子。邻居已经进了屋。

topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text_en: Priya found a note in her mailbox from the house next door. It said the owner planned to install a fence and would appreciate her input on the design. She called the number listed. They discussed height and materials, and Priya asked about the existing gate that opened into her yard. The neighbor explained they’d install a new gate for her. Priya said that sounded workable. They agreed to meet at the property line on Saturday. Priya hung up and made a note on the calendar. The rest of the day went on as usual.
text_zh: 普里亚在邮箱里发现了一张隔壁邻居留下的便条。上面说房主计划安装一道栅栏，希望就设计征求她的意见。她拨打了上面留的电话。他们讨论了高度和材料，普里亚问起那扇通向自家院子的现有大门。邻居解释说会为她装一扇新门。普里亚说这样听起来可行。他们约好周六在地界线上见面。普里亚挂了电话，在日历上做了个记号。那天剩下的时间照常度过。

topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text_en: Tom was trimming the hedge when his neighbor waved him over. The neighbor said he was thinking of putting up a chain-link fence to keep his dog in. Tom looked at the boundary, where the hedge sat entirely on his side. He said the fence would need to go on the neighbor’s side of the hedge. The neighbor agreed. They talked about the gate placement and the height. Tom said he didn’t have any objection as long as the hedge wasn’t disturbed. The neighbor said he’d make sure of it. They parted and Tom resumed trimming.
text_zh: 汤姆正在修剪树篱，邻居朝他挥手让他过去。邻居说他正考虑装一道铁丝网栅栏，好把狗圈住。汤姆看了看地界，树篱完全在他这边。他说栅栏得建在邻居那侧的树篱边上。邻居同意了。他们讨论了大门的位置和高度。汤姆说只要不破坏树篱，他没有异议。邻居说他会确保这一点。两人道别后，汤姆继续修剪。

topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text_en: Elena saw a contractor measuring her backyard one morning. She went out and asked what was happening. The contractor said her neighbor had hired him to install a fence along the back line. Elena walked over to her neighbor’s house and knocked. The neighbor explained they wanted more privacy from the alley. Elena mentioned the utility easement that ran along the back. The neighbor said they’d checked and the fence could go inside the easement. Elena said she’d prefer to see the plans. The neighbor said they’d drop them off that evening. Elena returned home and waited.
text_zh: 一天早上，埃琳娜看到一个承包商在量她家后院的尺寸。她走出去问是怎么回事。承包商说她的邻居雇他来沿着后边界安装一道栅栏。埃琳娜走到邻居家门口敲了敲门。邻居解释说他们想避开巷子，获得更多隐私。埃琳娜提到了沿着后院延伸的公用设施地役权。邻居说他们查过了，栅栏可以建在地役权范围内。埃琳娜说她更想看看规划图。邻居说他们今晚会把图纸送过来。埃琳娜回到家等着。

topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text_en: Rafael noticed a stack of cedar pickets in his neighbor’s driveway. Later, the neighbor came over and said he was going to build a fence between their yards. Rafael asked about the shared water spigot that was near the boundary. The neighbor said he’d leave access. Rafael nodded and said that would be fine. He asked when construction would start. The neighbor said next week. Rafael mentioned he had a garden on that side and hoped the workers would be careful. The neighbor said he’d tell them. Rafael thanked him and went back to his porch.
text_zh: 拉斐尔注意到邻居车道上堆着一摞雪松木桩。后来，邻居过来，说他打算在两家院子之间建一道栅栏。拉斐尔问起靠近地界的那个共用水龙头。邻居说他会留出通道。拉斐尔点点头，说那样就好。他问什么时候开工。邻居说下周。拉斐尔提到他在那边有个花园，希望工人们能小心些。邻居说他会转告他们。拉斐尔道了谢，回到门廊上。

topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text_en: The first thing Doreen saw was the string line stretched across the lawn. Her neighbor was standing by it, holding a stake. She walked over. He said he was marking the fence line and wanted to talk about the corner where her shed sat. Doreen said the shed had been there for years. He said the fence could go around it. She asked about the height and style. He showed her a picture on his phone. She said that seemed reasonable. He said he’d get the permit and let her know the start date. Doreen went back to her weeding.
text_zh: 多琳首先看到的是横在草坪上的拉线。她的邻居站在线旁，手里拿着一根木桩。她走过去。他说他正在标出栅栏线，想谈谈她工具棚所在的那个角落。多琳说那个工具棚已经在那里好多年了。他说栅栏可以绕过它。她问起高度和样式。他在手机上给她看了一张照片。她说那看起来挺合理。他说他会去办许可证，然后告诉她开工日期。多琳回去继续除草。

topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text_en: Marcus heard the hammering next door and looked out. His neighbor was putting up temporary posts. Marcus went over and asked what was going on. The neighbor said he was installing a fence and wanted to start that weekend. Marcus mentioned the large maple whose roots crossed the boundary. The neighbor said he’d adjust the line to avoid the roots. Marcus said he appreciated that. He asked if the fence would block the view from his kitchen window. The neighbor said it would be a semi-private design. Marcus said okay and went back inside.
text_zh: 马库斯听到隔壁传来敲击声，便向外看去。他的邻居正在立临时木桩。马库斯走过去问是怎么回事。邻居说他正在安装栅栏，想在那个周末开工。马库斯提到了那棵大枫树，它的树根延伸过了地界。邻居说他会调整线路以避开树根。马库斯说很感激。他问栅栏会不会挡住他厨房窗户的视线。邻居说那将是一种半私密的设计。马库斯说好吧，然后回了屋。

topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text_en: A letter arrived from the homeowners association about a fence application. Janet read it, then looked at her neighbor’s yard. She called her neighbor to ask about it. The neighbor said they were planning a vinyl fence along the side yard. Janet mentioned the easement for the cable line. The neighbor said they’d already confirmed it was clear. Janet asked about the color. The neighbor said white, matching the house. Janet said she’d look at the application and get back to them. She hung up and placed the letter on the counter.
text_zh: 业主协会寄来了一封关于栅栏申请的信。珍妮特读完后，看了看邻居家的院子。她打电话给邻居询问此事。邻居说他们计划沿着侧院建一道乙烯基栅栏。珍妮特提到了电缆线的地役权。邻居说他们已经确认那里没有障碍。珍妮特问起颜色。邻居说是白色的，和房子相配。珍妮特说她会看看申请，然后给他们答复。她挂了电话，把信放在台面上。

topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text_en: Owen was reading on his deck when his neighbor appeared at the fence. The neighbor said he was going to replace the old fence with a taller one. Owen looked at the existing fence, which was low and weathered. He said he’d grown used to the open view. The neighbor said he understood, but he wanted more privacy. Owen asked if they could compromise on a height. The neighbor said he’d think about it. They left it at that. Owen went back to his book, and the neighbor returned to his yard.
text_zh: 欧文正在露台上看书，这时邻居出现在栅栏边。邻居说他打算把旧栅栏换成更高的。欧文看了看现有的栅栏，它又矮又旧。他说他已经习惯了开阔的视野。邻居说他理解，但他想要更多隐私。欧文问他们能否在高度上折中一下。邻居说他会考虑。事情就到此为止。欧文继续看书，邻居回到了自己的院子。

topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text_en: Sandra’s son came in from playing and said the neighbor was digging holes. Sandra went out to see. The neighbor was marking post holes along the boundary. She asked what he was doing. He said he was installing a fence for his new puppy. Sandra mentioned that her rose bushes were close to the line. He said he’d keep the fence on his side. Sandra asked about the gate. He said there’d be one for his backyard. Sandra said that was fine. She watched for a moment, then went back inside to start dinner.
text_zh: 桑德拉的儿子玩耍回来，说邻居在挖洞。桑德拉出去看了看。邻居正在沿着边界标记围栏桩的位置。她问他在做什么。他说他正在为他的新小狗安装围栏。桑德拉提到她的玫瑰丛离边界很近。他说他会把围栏建在他自己那边。桑德拉问起大门的事。他说他的后院会有一个门。桑德拉说那没问题。她看了一会儿，然后回到屋里开始做晚饭。

topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text_en: The next-door neighbor left a voicemail for Isaac while he was at work. The message said he wanted to put up a fence and would like to discuss it. Isaac called back that evening. The neighbor explained he wanted a wooden fence along the back. Isaac asked about the shared driveway. The neighbor said the fence wouldn’t affect it. Isaac said he’d like to see a diagram. The neighbor said he’d email one. Isaac gave his email and said he’d review it. They said goodnight and hung up. Isaac checked his email before bed.
text_zh: 隔壁邻居在艾萨克上班时给他留了语音邮件。留言说他想建一道围栏，想和他商量一下。艾萨克当晚回了电话。邻居解释说他想沿着后院建一道木栅栏。艾萨克问起共用车道的事。邻居说围栏不会影响它。艾萨克说他想看一张示意图。邻居说他会发一封电子邮件。艾萨克给了他的邮箱，并说他会审阅。他们道了晚安，然后挂了电话。艾萨克睡前查看了他的电子邮件。

topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text_en: The note from the landlord said a fence would be installed along the back boundary next month. Lena read it twice while standing in the hallway. She had not thought much about the yard before. Her cat liked to sit on the porch, and the neighbor’s dog sometimes barked through the gap in the hedge. The fence would change that. She went outside and looked at the line where the posts would go. The ground was uneven there, with a few old bricks. She wondered how deep they would dig. Then she went back inside to finish her laundry, leaving the note on the table.
text_zh: 房东的便条上说，下个月将沿着后边界安装一道围栏。莉娜站在走廊里读了两遍。她以前对院子没怎么想过。她的猫喜欢坐在门廊上，邻居的狗有时会透过树篱的缝隙吠叫。围栏会改变这一切。她走到外面，看了看将要立桩的那条线。那里的地面不平，有几块旧砖。她想知道他们会挖多深。然后她回到屋里继续洗衣服，把便条留在了桌子上。

topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text_en: A contractor knocked on Brian’s door and asked about access to the backyard. Brian asked why. The contractor said the neighbor had hired him to build a fence. Brian said he’d need to talk to the neighbor first. He called the neighbor, who confirmed the plan. Brian mentioned the compost bin he kept near the boundary. The neighbor said the fence would go on the other side of it. Brian said that would be fine. He told the contractor he could use the side gate. The contractor thanked him and left.
text_zh: 一个承包商敲了布莱恩的门，询问能否进入后院。布莱恩问为什么。承包商说邻居雇他来建围栏。布莱恩说他需要先和邻居谈谈。他打电话给邻居，邻居确认了计划。布莱恩提到他放在边界附近的堆肥箱。邻居说围栏会建在它的另一边。布莱恩说那没问题。他告诉承包商可以使用侧门。承包商感谢了他，然后离开了。

topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text_en: Lucia noticed her neighbor pacing the yard with a measuring tape. She went out and asked if he needed help. He said he was planning a fence and trying to decide where to put the gate. Lucia pointed out that the gate would be convenient if it opened toward the alley. He said that made sense. He asked if she had any preference for the fence material. She said she didn’t mind, as long as it wasn’t too tall. He said he’d keep it low. He thanked her and continued measuring.
text_zh: 露西亚注意到邻居拿着卷尺在院子里踱步。她走出去问他是否需要帮助。他说他正在规划一道围栏，并试图决定把门放在哪里。露西亚指出，如果门朝小巷开，会很方便。他说有道理。他问她是否对围栏材料有什么偏好。她说她不介意，只要不是太高就行。他说他会保持低矮。他感谢了她，然后继续测量。

topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text_en: When the contractor knocked, Paul opened the door and saw the truck parked at the curb. The man explained that the fence installation would start the next day and take about a week. Paul nodded and asked about the materials. The contractor showed him a sample of the wood and a drawing of the design. Paul looked at the drawing, then at the yard. The fence would run along the side where his rose bushes grew. He asked if the posts would interfere with the roots. The contractor said they would try to avoid them. Paul watched him drive away, then went back to watering the plants.
text_zh: 当承包商敲门时，保罗打开门，看到卡车停在路边。那人解释说围栏安装将于第二天开始，大约需要一周时间。保罗点点头，问起材料的事。承包商给他看了一块木头样品和一张设计图。保罗看了看图纸，又看了看院子。围栏将沿着他种玫瑰丛的那一侧延伸。他问木桩会不会妨碍根系。承包商说他们会尽量避免。保罗看着他开车离开，然后回去给植物浇水。

topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text_en: Nina’s neighbor called her on the phone. She said she wanted to install a fence and was calling to discuss it. Nina listened. The neighbor said she planned to use metal panels. Nina asked about the existing hedge. The neighbor said she’d keep the fence on her side. Nina said she’d like to see the color. The neighbor said she’d bring a sample over. Nina said okay. They hung up. Later that day, the neighbor came by with a small piece of metal. Nina looked at it and said it was fine. The neighbor left.
text_zh: 尼娜的邻居给她打了电话。她说她想安装一道围栏，打电话来是想商量一下。尼娜听着。邻居说她打算用金属板。尼娜问起现有的树篱。邻居说她会把围栏建在她自己那边。尼娜说她想看看颜色。邻居说她会带样品过来。尼娜说好的。他们挂了电话。当天晚些时候，邻居带着一小块金属过来了。尼娜看了看，说没问题。邻居离开了。

topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text_en: Alice came home to find a stack of fence panels leaning against her garage. Her neighbor had mentioned the plan a few weeks ago, but she had forgotten the exact date. She walked over and knocked on his door. He came out, wiping his hands on a rag. They stood in the driveway, looking at the panels. He said the crew would start on Monday. Alice asked about the gate placement, since she sometimes used the path to the alley. He said they could adjust it. She thanked him and went inside. The panels were still there when she looked out later, propped against the garage wall.
text_zh: 爱丽丝回到家，发现一摞围栏板靠在她的车库上。她的邻居几周前提过这个计划，但她忘了确切的日期。她走过去敲了敲他的门。他出来了，用抹布擦着手。他们站在车道上，看着那些板子。他说施工队星期一开始。爱丽丝问起大门的位置，因为她有时会走那条通往小巷的小路。他说他们可以调整。她感谢了他，然后进了屋。后来她往外看时，那些板子还在那里，靠在车库墙上。

topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text_en: Marta noticed the orange stakes lined up along the property line while she was pulling weeds from her front bed. Her neighbor, Dan, waved from his yard as he unrolled a spool of wire fencing. They had shared the boundary for years without any barrier, and she had grown used to seeing his dog roam freely between their lawns. She stood up, brushing dirt from her knees, and walked over to ask about his plans. Dan explained that his new puppy kept wandering into the street. Marta nodded and mentioned that she would miss the open sightline, then returned to her weeding, occasionally glancing at the stakes as she worked.
text_zh: 玛尔塔正在前院花坛里拔草时，注意到沿着地界线排列的橙色标桩。她的邻居丹在自家院子里一边展开一卷铁丝网，一边向她挥手。多年来他们一直共用这条边界，没有任何屏障，她已经习惯看到他的狗在两家草坪之间自由奔跑。她站起来，拍掉膝盖上的泥土，走过去询问他的计划。丹解释说，他的新小狗总是跑到街上去。玛尔塔点点头，提到她会怀念那种开阔的视野，然后回到她的除草工作中，偶尔在工作时瞥一眼那些标桩。

topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text_en: The noise of an auger woke Victor early. He looked out the window and saw workers drilling post holes next door. He put on shoes and went out. The neighbor was supervising. Victor asked what was happening. The neighbor said they were installing a fence. Victor mentioned that his sprinkler line ran close to the boundary. The neighbor said they’d be careful. Victor asked if they could pause while he marked the line. The neighbor agreed. Victor went to his garage, found some flags, and placed them along the yard. The workers waited until he was done.
text_zh: 螺旋钻的噪音早早吵醒了维克多。他望向窗外，看到工人们正在隔壁钻桩孔。他穿上鞋走了出去。邻居正在监督。维克多问发生了什么事。邻居说他们正在安装围栏。维克多提到他的洒水器管线离边界很近。邻居说他们会小心的。维克多问他们能否暂停一下，让他标出管线位置。邻居同意了。维克多去了他的车库，找到一些旗子，沿着院子放置。工人们一直等到他完成。

topic: An employee is asked to train their replacement
text_en: Marta showed Priya the filing system, explaining which folders went where. She pointed out the monthly report template on the shared drive and how to update the contact list. Her supervisor had mentioned that Priya would be taking over her duties after she left at the end of the month. Marta paused when Priya asked about the client follow-up schedule. She walked her through the spreadsheet, noting the color codes she used for different priority levels. They spent the afternoon reviewing the process, and Marta answered Priya's questions as they came up.
text_zh: 玛尔塔向普里亚展示了归档系统，解释了哪些文件夹该放在哪里。她指出了共享驱动器上的月度报告模板，以及如何更新联系人列表。她的主管曾提到，普里亚将在她月底离职后接管她的职责。当普里亚询问客户跟进时间表时，玛尔塔停顿了一下。她带她浏览了电子表格，指出了她用于不同优先级级别的颜色代码。她们花了一下午审查流程，玛尔塔逐一回答了普里亚提出的问题。

topic: An employee is asked to train their replacement
text_en: Evan walked Liam through the morning opening routine, showing him which lights to turn on and how to set up the registers. He explained that Liam would be handling these tasks once Evan moved to the other branch. They reviewed the inventory checklist together, and Evan demonstrated how to verify the delivery against the packing slips. When Liam asked about the weekly specials board, Evan showed him where the marker was kept and how to write the new items. They worked through the list, and Evan noted that Liam seemed to be getting the hang of it.
text_zh: 埃文带利亚姆熟悉早间开门流程，告诉他该开哪些灯以及如何设置收银机。他解释说，一旦埃文调到另一个分店，利亚姆将负责这些任务。他们一起检查了库存清单，埃文演示了如何根据装箱单核对送货。当利亚姆询问每周特价板时，埃文告诉他记号笔放在哪里，以及如何写上新商品。他们逐项完成了清单，埃文注意到利亚姆似乎已经上手了。

topic: An employee is asked to train their replacement
text_en: Lena opened the scheduling software and walked Ray through the process of assigning shifts. She told him he would be managing the schedule after her transfer went through. They reviewed the call-in procedure and the list of employees who could cover last-minute openings. Ray asked about the overtime rules, and Lena pulled up the policy document to show him. They went through the upcoming week's schedule together, adjusting a few shifts to account for the holidays. Lena pointed out the notes section where she kept reminders about staff preferences and availability.
text_zh: 莉娜打开了排班软件，带雷熟悉分配班次的过程。她告诉他，她的调动完成后，他将负责管理排班。他们审查了请假来电流程，以及可以临时顶班的员工名单。雷询问了加班规定，莉娜调出政策文件给他看。他们一起查看了下周的排班，调整了几个班次以应对假期。莉娜指出了备注栏，她在那里记录了关于员工偏好和可用时间的提醒。

topic: An employee is asked to train their replacement
text_en: The hospital's billing office was quiet when Dana introduced herself to the new coder, Mark. Her supervisor had told her to bring him up to speed because he'd be taking over her accounts. Dana pulled up the software and walked him through the claim forms, explaining the codes and the deadlines. Mark listened and typed notes on his keyboard. They reviewed several cases together, and Dana corrected a couple of his entries. She showed him where to find the policy updates and how to flag missing information. By the afternoon, Mark was processing a claim while Dana watched.
text_zh: 医院的收费办公室很安静，达娜向新来的编码员马克做了自我介绍。她的主管让她带他熟悉工作，因为他将接管她的账户。达娜打开软件，带他浏览了索赔表格，解释了编码和截止日期。马克一边听，一边在键盘上打字记录。他们一起审查了几个案例，达娜纠正了他几处录入。她告诉他去哪里找政策更新，以及如何标记缺失的信息。到了下午，马克在达娜的注视下处理一份索赔。

topic: An employee is asked to train their replacement
text_en: Priya showed Noah how to process the incoming orders, scanning each one and entering the details into the system. Her manager had introduced Noah as her successor, who would take over her position when she moved to the new department. They worked through a stack of orders, and Priya explained how to flag any discrepancies for review. Noah asked about the shipping labels, and Priya demonstrated how to print and attach them. They handled the afternoon's orders together, and Priya mentioned that Noah would be doing this on his own soon.
text_zh: 普里亚向诺亚展示了如何处理收到的订单，扫描每一份并将详细信息输入系统。她的经理介绍诺亚是她的继任者，她调到新部门后，他将接管她的职位。他们处理了一叠订单，普里亚解释了如何标记任何差异以供审查。诺亚询问了运输标签，普里亚演示了如何打印和粘贴。他们一起处理了下午的订单，普里亚提到诺亚很快就要独自做这些了。

topic: An employee is asked to train their replacement
text_en: Marta pulled up a second chair beside her desk and gestured for Theo to sit. She had been at the company for years, and her manager had asked her to show him the ropes before her transfer to another branch. She opened the shared drive and walked him through the client intake process, explaining which forms needed signatures and how she logged follow-ups. He asked a few clarifying questions, and she answered them while checking her inbox. At lunch, she ate at her desk, letting him shadow her through a routine call with a vendor. By the end of the day, she had finished her own tasks and left a detailed note for him on the shared folder.
text_zh: 玛尔塔在办公桌旁拉过第二把椅子，示意西奥坐下。她在这家公司工作多年，她的经理请她在调到另一个分店之前带他熟悉工作。她打开共享驱动器，带他了解了客户接待流程，解释了哪些表格需要签名，以及她如何记录跟进。他问了几个澄清性的问题，她一边查看收件箱一边回答。午餐时，她在办公桌前吃饭，让他跟着她打了一通与供应商的例行电话。一天结束时，她完成了自己的任务，并在共享文件夹里给他留了一张详细的便条。

topic: An employee is asked to train their replacement
text_en: Priya had been the office manager for years, and now she was showing Amir the ropes. She walked him through the filing system, the vendor contacts, and the way she scheduled maintenance requests. He took notes in a small notebook, asking for clarification on a few points. Priya demonstrated how to handle the monthly supply order, and Amir repeated the steps back to her. They worked through the morning, pausing only for a quick lunch break. By the afternoon, Amir was processing a request on his own while Priya sorted old files. She figured he would manage fine once she left.
text_zh: 普里亚担任办公室经理多年，现在她在带阿米尔熟悉工作。她带他了解了归档系统、供应商联系人，以及她安排维护请求的方式。他在一个小笔记本上做笔记，就几个要点请求澄清。普里亚演示了如何处理每月的供应订单，阿米尔向她复述了步骤。他们工作了一上午，只短暂休息吃了午饭。到了下午，阿米尔在普里亚整理旧文件时，独自处理了一个请求。她觉得她离开后他能应付得来。

topic: An employee is asked to train their replacement
text_en: The bakery manager stood beside Sam at the counter and explained the daily sales report. He said Sam would be running the store after the manager relocated to the main office. They went over the cash drawer procedure and how to reconcile the receipts at closing. Sam asked about the delivery schedule, and the manager pulled up the route list to show him. They checked the display cases and noted which items needed restocking. The manager handed Sam the keys to the back room and let him handle the next customer order.
text_zh: 面包店经理站在柜台旁的山姆身边，解释了每日销售报告。他说经理调到主办公室后，山姆将负责经营这家店。他们检查了现金抽屉流程，以及打烊时如何核对收据。山姆询问了送货时间表，经理调出路线列表给他看。他们检查了展示柜，并记下哪些商品需要补货。经理把后屋的钥匙交给山姆，让他处理下一个顾客的订单。

topic: An employee is asked to train their replacement
text_en: Julia brought Amy into the conference room and laid out the client files on the table. She told Amy that she would be taking over the account management role once Julia's maternity leave began. They reviewed the key accounts and the notes Julia had made about each one. Amy asked about the quarterly reviews, and Julia showed her the template she used. They went through the current projects and discussed the upcoming deadlines. Julia gave Amy the contact list and suggested she reach out to a few clients to introduce herself.
text_zh: 朱莉娅把艾米带进会议室，把客户档案摊在桌上。她告诉艾米，一旦朱莉娅的产假开始，她将接管客户管理角色。她们审查了主要账户以及朱莉娅为每个账户所做的笔记。艾米询问了季度审查，朱莉娅向她展示了她使用的模板。她们浏览了当前项目，并讨论了即将到来的截止日期。朱莉娅把联系人名单给了艾米，并建议她联系几位客户做自我介绍。

topic: An employee is asked to train their replacement
text_en: The head chef called Leo over to the prep station and handed him a knife. He explained that Leo would be taking over the lunch service after the chef's departure next week. They worked through the menu together, and the chef showed Leo how to prepare the signature sauce. Leo asked about the portion sizes, and the chef demonstrated with a few plates. They prepped the vegetables for the evening shift, and the chef pointed out the order in which the dishes were assembled. Leo took notes as they worked.
text_zh: 主厨把利奥叫到备餐台，递给他一把刀。他解释说，主厨下周离职后，利奥将接管午餐服务。他们一起研究了菜单，主厨向利奥展示了如何制作招牌酱汁。利奥询问了份量大小，主厨用几个盘子做了演示。他们为晚班准备了蔬菜，主厨指出了菜肴组装的顺序。利奥一边工作一边做笔记。

topic: An employee is asked to train their replacement
text_en: When Daniel was told to train the new hire, he cleared a space at his desk and pulled up the project files. Elena sat beside him, ready with a pen and a notepad. Daniel explained the client's preferences, the reporting format, and the deadlines they usually worked with. He showed her the template he used for status updates and the way he tracked revisions. Elena asked a few questions, and Daniel answered them, then let her try filling out a sample form. She made a couple of mistakes, which he corrected. They went through the process again until she seemed comfortable with it.
text_zh: 当丹尼尔被告知要培训新员工时，他在办公桌前清理出一块空间，并调出了项目文件。埃琳娜坐在他旁边，准备好了笔和记事本。丹尼尔解释了客户的偏好、报告格式以及他们通常遵循的截止日期。他向她展示了他用于状态更新的模板以及他跟踪修订的方式。埃琳娜问了几个问题，丹尼尔回答了，然后让她尝试填写一份样表。她犯了几个错误，他纠正了。他们又重复了一遍这个过程，直到她看起来熟悉了。

topic: An employee is asked to train their replacement
text_en: Ruth had been a teller at the bank for over a decade, and now she was showing Marcus how to handle the morning cash count. She demonstrated the procedure step by step, explaining how to verify the amounts and record any discrepancies. Marcus watched carefully, then tried it himself while Ruth observed. He got the hang of it quickly, though he double-checked his totals a few times. Ruth showed him the vault log and the security protocols, then let him process a few transactions. By the end of the shift, Marcus was managing the window on his own, and Ruth felt the transition was going smoothly.
text_zh: 露丝在银行担任出纳员已有十多年，现在她正在向马库斯展示如何处理早晨的现金清点。她一步一步地演示了流程，解释了如何核对金额并记录任何差异。马库斯仔细观看，然后在露丝观察时自己尝试了一遍。他很快就掌握了要领，尽管他几次复核了总数。露丝向他展示了金库日志和安全协议，然后让他处理了几笔交易。到轮班结束时，马库斯已经能独立处理窗口业务，露丝觉得交接进展顺利。

topic: An employee is asked to train their replacement
text_en: Tom was a senior technician at the repair shop, and his boss asked him to train the new guy, Sam. Tom started by showing Sam the diagnostic equipment and the common issues they saw in appliances. He explained how to read error codes and replace faulty parts. Sam watched and helped where he could, handing Tom tools and asking questions. They worked on a washing machine together, and Tom pointed out the worn belt and the way to access the motor. Sam seemed to pick up the basics, so Tom let him try a simple repair on his own while he watched. It took a bit longer, but the job got done.
text_zh: 汤姆是修理厂的高级技师，他的老板让他培训新来的萨姆。汤姆首先向萨姆展示了诊断设备以及他们在电器中常见的故障。他解释了如何读取错误代码和更换故障部件。萨姆在一旁观看并尽可能帮忙，给汤姆递工具并提问。他们一起修理了一台洗衣机，汤姆指出了磨损的皮带和检修电机的方法。萨姆似乎掌握了基础知识，所以汤姆让他在自己观看下尝试独立进行一项简单的修理。虽然花的时间长了一些，但工作完成了。

topic: An employee is asked to train their replacement
text_en: Nina had been the events coordinator for the community center, and her replacement, Carlos, was starting that week. She showed him the calendar of upcoming events, the list of vendors, and the way she handled bookings. They went through the files for the annual fundraiser, and Nina explained how she coordinated with the caterer and the volunteers. Carlos took notes and asked about the sound system, which she demonstrated in the main hall. They walked through the setup for the next event, and Carlos helped arrange the chairs. Nina felt he was getting a good sense of the job.
text_zh: 尼娜一直是社区中心的活动协调员，她的接替者卡洛斯那周开始工作。她向他展示了即将举行的活动日历、供应商名单以及她处理预订的方式。他们翻阅了年度筹款活动的文件，尼娜解释了她如何与餐饮服务商和志愿者协调。卡洛斯做了笔记，并询问了音响系统的情况，她在主厅演示了该系统。他们走了一遍下一场活动的布置流程，卡洛斯帮忙摆放了椅子。尼娜觉得他对工作有了很好的了解。

topic: An employee is asked to train their replacement
text_en: Raj adjusted his monitor to show the inventory spreadsheet and looked over at Priya, who had been hired to take over his role when he moved to the night shift. He started with the ordering system, showing her which suppliers to contact for restocking and how he flagged items that were running low. She took notes on a small pad, occasionally asking him to repeat a step. He paused to help a customer at the counter, then resumed where he had left off. When the phone rang, he let her answer it, listening as she handled the inquiry. Before his shift ended, he gave her the list of emergency contacts, tucked in the back of the drawer.
text_zh: 拉杰调整了显示器以显示库存电子表格，然后看向普里亚，她是在他转到夜班时被雇来接替他职位的。他从订购系统开始，向她展示哪些供应商需要联系补货，以及他如何标记库存不足的物品。她在一个小本子上做笔记，偶尔请他重复某个步骤。他停下来在柜台帮助一位顾客，然后从停下的地方继续。电话响起时，他让她接听，听她处理询问。在他的轮班结束前，他把紧急联系人名单给了她，名单放在抽屉后面。

topic: An employee is asked to train their replacement
text_en: When the manager asked Frank to train his replacement, he wasn't sure where to start. He'd been doing the same job for years, and it had become routine. He began by showing the new guy, Alex, the daily checklist and the key contacts. They went through the morning tasks together, with Frank explaining why each step mattered. Alex shadowed him for a few days, asking questions and taking notes. Frank let him handle some tasks on his own, and he corrected a few mistakes. By the end of the second week, Alex was working independently, and Frank was just there for occasional questions.
text_zh: 当经理让弗兰克培训他的接替者时，他不知道从哪里开始。他做同样的工作已经多年，这已成为例行公事。他首先向新来的亚历克斯展示了每日清单和主要联系人。他们一起完成了早上的任务，弗兰克解释了每一步为什么重要。亚历克斯跟随他学习了几天，提问并做笔记。弗兰克让他独立处理一些任务，并纠正了一些错误。到第二周结束时，亚历克斯已经能独立工作，弗兰克只是偶尔回答一些问题。

topic: An employee is asked to train their replacement
text_en: Grace was a dental hygienist, and she was asked to show the new hire, Dana, the office procedures. She demonstrated how to prepare the treatment room, sterilize the instruments, and update patient records. Dana watched and then tried setting up a tray herself, with Grace checking her work. They went over the schedule for the day, and Grace explained how to handle cancellations and reminders. Dana was quick to learn, and by the afternoon, she was assisting with a cleaning while Grace observed. Grace thought Dana would fit in well with the team.
text_zh: 格蕾丝是一名牙科保健员，她被要求向新员工达娜展示办公室流程。她演示了如何准备治疗室、消毒器械和更新患者记录。达娜观看，然后自己尝试设置一个托盘，格蕾丝检查她的工作。他们查看了当天的日程安排，格蕾丝解释了如何处理取消和提醒。达娜学得很快，到下午时，她已经在格蕾丝观察下协助进行了一次清洁。格蕾丝认为达娜会很好地融入团队。

topic: An employee is asked to train their replacement
text_en: For the past several years, Peter had managed the stockroom at the retail store. When his supervisor introduced the new employee, Maya, as his replacement, Peter began showing her the layout and the inventory system. He explained how to receive shipments, check packing slips, and organize the shelves. Maya helped him unload a delivery, and they worked through the process together. Peter showed her how to use the handheld scanner and where to put items that needed to be marked down. Maya seemed to catch on quickly, and Peter was satisfied that she would be able to handle the job.
text_zh: 过去几年，彼得一直在零售店的仓库工作。当他的主管介绍新员工玛雅作为他的接替者时，彼得开始向她展示布局和库存系统。他解释了如何接收货物、检查装箱单以及整理货架。玛雅帮他卸了一批货，他们一起完成了这个过程。彼得向她展示了如何使用手持扫描仪，以及把需要降价处理的物品放在哪里。玛雅似乎学得很快，彼得很满意她能够胜任这项工作。

topic: An employee is asked to train their replacement
text_en: Hannah was a lab technician, and her replacement, a young woman named Jess, had just started. Hannah showed her how to prepare samples, operate the centrifuge, and record results in the database. She explained the safety protocols and the importance of labeling everything correctly. Jess watched closely and then tried preparing a sample on her own, with Hannah nearby to answer questions. They ran a few tests together, and Jess seemed to understand the steps. Hannah let her log the results while she double-checked the numbers. She thought Jess would do fine once she got more experience.
text_zh: 汉娜是一名实验室技术员，她的接替者，一位名叫杰丝的年轻女子，刚刚开始工作。汉娜向她展示了如何准备样本、操作离心机以及在数据库中记录结果。她解释了安全规程以及正确标记所有物品的重要性。杰丝仔细观察，然后自己尝试准备一个样本，汉娜在旁边回答问题。他们一起进行了几项测试，杰丝似乎理解了这些步骤。汉娜让她记录结果，同时她复核了数字。她认为杰丝一旦获得更多经验，就会做得很好。

topic: An employee is asked to train their replacement
text_en: Elena cleared a space on the workbench and laid out the calibration tools for Sam, who had just been hired to replace her when she transferred to the other plant. She showed him how she zeroed the equipment each morning and walked him through the logbook where she recorded the readings. He watched closely, then tried a few measurements himself while she observed. When he made a small error, she corrected it and explained the standard procedure again. She answered his questions between tasks and showed him where the spare parts were stored. At the end of the afternoon, she packed her personal tools into a box, leaving the bench tidy for him to use the next day.
text_zh: 埃琳娜在工作台上清理出一块空间，为萨姆摆好了校准工具，萨姆刚被雇来接替她，因为她要调到另一家工厂。她向他展示了她每天早上如何将设备归零，并带他浏览了记录读数的日志本。他仔细观察，然后在她观察下自己尝试了几次测量。当他犯了一个小错误时，她纠正了，并再次解释了标准程序。她在任务间隙回答了他的问题，并向他展示了备件存放的位置。下午结束时，她把个人工具装进一个箱子，把工作台收拾得干干净净，留给他第二天使用。

topic: An athlete is asked to switch positions
text_en: When the coach asked Mia to move from striker to midfield, she listened to the reasoning about the team's balance. At practice, she ran the new lanes and passed more than shot. Her timing felt off in the first scrimmage, and she kept drifting forward out of habit. After a few drills, she started reading the play earlier. She talked with the coach about where to position herself during corners. By the end of the session, she was finding open spaces and connecting with the forwards. She still thought about her old role but focused on learning the new one.
text_zh: 当教练要求米娅从前锋改打中场时，她听取了关于球队平衡的理由。训练中，她跑动新的路线，传球多于射门。在第一次分队比赛中，她的时机感觉不对，而且她习惯性地向前漂移。经过几次训练后，她开始更早地阅读比赛。她和教练讨论了在角球时应该如何站位。到训练结束时，她能够找到空当并与前锋衔接。她仍然想着自己原来的角色，但专注于学习新的角色。

topic: An athlete is asked to switch positions
text_en: Marta had played wing for her club team since she joined, but the new coach wanted her at fullback. At practice, she ran through the drills from that position, tracking the forwards and clearing balls toward the sideline. Her first touch felt awkward, and she misjudged a long pass that sailed over her head. Afterward, she stayed late, taking repetitions with a teammate who offered to feed her balls. She collected the scattered balls and walked off the field, still thinking about positioning. The next morning, she packed her boots and headed to practice again.
text_zh: 玛尔塔自从加入俱乐部球队以来一直踢边锋，但新教练希望她踢后卫。训练中，她按照这个位置进行训练，追踪前锋并将球解围到边线。她的第一次触球感觉很别扭，而且她误判了一记长传，球从她头顶飞过。之后，她留下来加练，与一位主动给她喂球的队友一起反复练习。她收集散落的球，走出球场，仍然在思考站位问题。第二天早上，她收拾好球鞋，再次前往训练场。

topic: An athlete is asked to switch positions
text_en: Priya had been a setter since college, but her new team needed her as an outside hitter. She arrived early to the gym and worked with the assistant coach on approach footwork. The first few swings felt awkward, her timing off against the blockers. She repeated the drill until her steps began to feel more natural. During the team drill, she called for the ball and took a solid hit down the line. Her teammate gave her a thumbs-up. After practice, she stayed to stretch and thought about the adjustments she would need for the next match.
text_zh: 普里亚从大学起就一直担任二传手，但她的新球队需要她打主攻。她提前到达体育馆，与助理教练一起练习助跑步伐。最初的几次扣球感觉很别扭，她的时机在对抗拦网时把握不好。她反复练习这个动作，直到步伐开始变得更自然。在球队训练中，她喊球并打出了一记漂亮的直线扣球。她的队友向她竖起了大拇指。训练结束后，她留下来拉伸，并思考下一场比赛需要做出的调整。

topic: An athlete is asked to switch positions
text_en: Carlos was asked to move from offensive line to defensive line during the spring practices. He spent the morning learning the new stance and the gap responsibilities. The defensive coach showed him how to read the offense's first step. Carlos felt clumsy when he tried to shed blocks with the new technique.
