text_zh: 在整理车库里的旧箱子时，米格尔发现了一个他不认识的小木箱。他打开它，发现里面有几张旧照片、一把小刀和一封信。照片显示一群人在野餐，但米格尔一个也不认识。信是写给一个叫“M.”的人的，提到了一次山区旅行。米格尔的名字以M开头，但他不记得曾进行过这样的旅行。他把所有东西放回箱子里，放在一边。

topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text_en: Maya was sorting the laundry when a folded paper slipped from Liam's jacket pocket. It was a list, handwritten, with items like "see the northern lights" and "learn to make sourdough." She read it twice, noting a few items were crossed out, like "run a half marathon." She placed it back in the jacket, folded neatly. That evening, she asked Liam if he'd ever considered making a list of things to do. He shrugged and mentioned an old one he'd started years ago. Maya nodded, then went back to folding clothes, leaving the list where she'd found it.
text_zh: 玛雅正在整理衣物时，一张折叠的纸从利亚姆的夹克口袋里滑落。那是一张手写的清单，上面写着“看北极光”和“学会做酸面包”之类的项目。她读了两遍，注意到有些项目被划掉了，比如“跑半程马拉松”。她把纸重新叠好，放回了夹克里。那天晚上，她问利亚姆是否考虑过列一张想做的事情的清单。他耸耸肩，提到一张他多年前开始列的旧清单。玛雅点点头，然后继续叠衣服，把清单留在了她发现它的地方。

topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text_en: When Maya found the list tucked inside an old book on the shelf, she recognized his handwriting immediately. It was a list of places he wanted to visit, foods he wanted to try, and skills he wanted to learn. She had never seen it before, and he had never mentioned any of these dreams. She read through it slowly, noting the small details he had added over time—a checkmark next to a few items, a note about a particular sunset. She placed the list back where she found it and went to prepare dinner, thinking about the things he had chosen to keep private.
text_zh: 当玛雅发现那张清单夹在书架上一本旧书里时，她立刻认出了他的笔迹。那是一张清单，列着他想去的地方、想尝试的食物以及想学习的技能。她以前从未见过这张清单，他也从未提起过这些梦想中的任何一个。她慢慢读了一遍，注意到他随着时间添加的小细节——几个项目旁边有对勾，还有关于某次日落的备注。她把清单放回原处，然后去做晚饭，心里想着他选择保密的事情。

topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text_en: Priya was cleaning the study when she spotted a small notebook tucked behind the books on the shelf. She opened it and saw a list titled "Things to Do." It included "learn to paint with watercolors" and "take a cooking class." A few entries were crossed out, like "hike the Appalachian Trail." She closed the notebook and returned it to its spot. Later, she mentioned to her partner that she'd found an interesting notebook. He said it was old and he'd forgotten about it. Priya put it back and continued dusting.
text_zh: 普里亚正在打扫书房时，注意到书架上的书后面藏着一本小笔记本。她打开它，看到一张标题为“要做的事”的清单。上面包括“学水彩画”和“上烹饪课”。有几项被划掉了，比如“徒步阿巴拉契亚小径”。她合上笔记本，放回原处。后来，她告诉伴侣她发现了一本有趣的笔记本。他说那本笔记本很旧了，他已经忘了。普里亚把它放回去，继续掸灰尘。

topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text_en: Lena discovered the folded paper in the pocket of his jacket while looking for her keys. It was a bucket list, written in his neat handwriting, with several items crossed off and a few left open. She recognized some of the completed ones from their shared vacations, but others were unfamiliar. She read about a night spent camping under the stars and a cooking class he had taken before they met. She refolded the paper and slipped it back into the pocket, then hung the jacket in the closet. Later, she asked him about his favorite memory from that camping trip, and he smiled as he told her.
text_zh: 莉娜在找钥匙时，在他夹克口袋里发现了那张折叠的纸。那是一张遗愿清单，用他整洁的笔迹写成，有几项被划掉了，还有几项空着。她认出其中一些已完成的项目来自他们共同的假期，但其他项目她并不熟悉。她读到关于在星空下露营的一夜，以及他在他们相遇前上过的一堂烹饪课。她重新叠好纸，塞回口袋，然后把夹克挂进衣柜。后来，她问他关于那次露营旅行最喜欢的记忆，他微笑着告诉她。

topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text_en: Marcus found the list in the pocket of a jacket he was taking to the dry cleaner. It was a list of places to visit, like "see the cherry blossoms in Japan" and "visit the Great Wall." Some items were marked with a pen. He left the list in the pocket, not mentioning it. A week later, he asked his partner if they had any travel dreams. They talked about a few places, but the list never came up. Marcus shrugged and went back to sorting the laundry, leaving the list where it was.
text_zh: 马库斯在要送去干洗店的夹克口袋里发现了那张清单。那是一张要去的地方的清单，比如“在日本看樱花”和“参观长城”。有些项目用笔做了标记。他把清单留在口袋里，没有提起。一周后，他问伴侣是否有旅行梦想。他们聊了几个地方，但清单从未被提起。马库斯耸耸肩，继续整理衣物，把清单留在原处。

topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text_en: During a quiet afternoon at home, Rachel found a crumpled piece of paper in the drawer of the nightstand while looking for a pen. It was his bucket list, with a mix of ambitious and simple goals. Some items were marked with small checkmarks, while others had question marks beside them. She read about learning to play the guitar and visiting the northern lights. She hadn't known he had such a list, and she wondered when he had written it. She put it back in the drawer and later asked him if he had ever tried the guitar. He said he had, but gave up after a few lessons.
text_zh: 在一个安静的下午，雷切尔在家找笔时，在床头柜的抽屉里发现了一张皱巴巴的纸。那是他的遗愿清单，混合了雄心勃勃和简单的目标。有些项目旁边有小对勾，而其他项目旁边有问号。她读到关于学弹吉他和看北极光的内容。她不知道他有这样一张清单，她想知道他是什么时候写的。她把纸放回抽屉，后来问他是否试过弹吉他。他说他试过，但上了几节课后就放弃了。

topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text_en: While sorting through the stack of mail on the kitchen counter, Tom noticed a small notepad that had fallen behind the fruit bowl. It was his wife's bucket list, written in her flowing script. It included things like learning to paint, seeing the cherry blossoms in Japan, and running a marathon. He had heard her mention some of these dreams in passing, but never saw them all written down. He read through the list twice, then placed it back behind the fruit bowl. That evening, he asked her about her interest in painting, and she talked about it for a while, describing the colors she would use.
text_zh: 汤姆在厨房台面上整理一堆邮件时，注意到一个掉在水果碗后面的小记事本。那是他妻子的遗愿清单，用她流畅的笔迹写成。上面包括学画画、在日本看樱花和跑马拉松之类的事情。他以前听她随口提过其中一些梦想，但从未见过它们全部写下来。他读了两遍清单，然后把它放回水果碗后面。那天晚上，他问她关于画画的兴趣，她聊了一会儿，描述了她会使用的颜色。

topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text_en: Rachel was unpacking boxes in the new apartment when she found a folded paper in a book. It was a list of goals, including "learn to surf" and "visit a vineyard." A few items had checkmarks. She put the paper back in the book and placed it on the shelf. Later, she asked her partner about his bucket list. He said he'd made one years ago but didn't remember where it was. Rachel said she'd seen something like that in a book. He shrugged, and they went back to unpacking.
text_zh: 雷切尔在新公寓里打开箱子时，在一本书里发现了一张折叠的纸。那是一张目标清单，包括“学冲浪”和“参观葡萄园”。有几项有对勾。她把纸放回书里，然后把书放在书架上。后来，她问伴侣关于他的遗愿清单。他说他多年前列过一张，但不记得放在哪里了。雷切尔说她在书里见过类似的东西。他耸耸肩，然后他们继续打开箱子。

topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text_en: While cleaning the garage, David found a list taped to the inside of a toolbox. It had items like "go on a road trip" and "learn to fish." Some were crossed off. He removed the list, read it, and taped it back. Later, he mentioned to his partner that he was thinking about a weekend road trip. His partner said that sounded like fun and asked where he wanted to go. David suggested a few places, and they talked about it for a bit before going back to the garage.
text_zh: 大卫在打扫车库时，发现一张清单贴在工具箱内部。上面有“去公路旅行”和“学钓鱼”之类的项目。有些被划掉了。他取下清单，读了一遍，然后重新贴回去。后来，他告诉伴侣他在考虑一个周末公路旅行。伴侣说那听起来很有趣，并问他想去哪里。大卫建议了几个地方，他们聊了一会儿，然后回到车库。

topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text_en: Laura was looking for a specific recipe in the cookbook when she found a list tucked between the pages. It was a list of things to do, like "make homemade pasta" and "learn to make a soufflé." Some items had a checkmark. She left the list in the book and closed it. That night, she asked her partner if they'd ever tried making pasta from scratch. He said he'd thought about it. Laura mentioned she'd seen a recipe for it, and they agreed to try it soon. The list stayed in the cookbook.
text_zh: 劳拉在烹饪书中寻找一个特定食谱时，发现了一张夹在书页之间的清单。那是一张要做的事情的清单，比如“做自制意大利面”和“学会做舒芙蕾”。有些项目有对勾。她把清单留在书里，合上了书。那天晚上，她问伴侣是否试过从头开始做意大利面。他说他考虑过。劳拉提到她见过一个食谱，他们同意很快尝试。清单留在了烹饪书里。

topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text_en: In the glove compartment of the car, Anna found a folded piece of paper while looking for the registration. It was a bucket list written by her partner, with items like skydiving, learning to sail, and visiting a desert. Some items had dates written next to them, but most were undated. She recognized a few from their conversations, but others were completely new to her. She read the list and then folded it back up, placing it where she had found it. Later, she mentioned that she had always wanted to see a desert, and he said they should plan a trip sometime.
text_zh: 在汽车的手套箱里，安娜在找登记证时发现了一张折叠的纸。那是她伴侣写的一份遗愿清单，上面有跳伞、学帆船和参观沙漠等项目。有些项目旁边写着日期，但大多数没有日期。她认出了其中一些是他们聊过的，但其他的对她来说完全是新的。她读了清单，然后把它折好，放回原处。后来，她提到她一直想看看沙漠，他说他们应该找个时间计划一次旅行。

topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text_en: Ava was sorting through the closet when she found a small notebook in a box. It was a list of things to do, like "learn to knit" and "visit a national park." Some had checkmarks. She put the notebook back in the box. Later, she asked her partner about their goals. Her partner said they used to have a list but didn't know where it was. Ava said she'd seen a box in the closet. Her partner said they'd look through it later. She nodded and went back to sorting.
text_zh: 艾娃在整理衣柜时，在一个盒子里发现了一本小笔记本。那是一份待办事项清单，比如“学编织”和“参观国家公园”。有些打了勾。她把笔记本放回了盒子里。后来，她问她的伴侣关于他们的目标。她的伴侣说他们曾经有一份清单，但不知道在哪里。艾娃说她在衣柜里看到了一个盒子。她的伴侣说他们稍后会去查看。她点了点头，继续整理。

topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text_en: Chris was looking for a screwdriver in the utility drawer when he found a list of things to do. It had items like "build a birdhouse" and "plant a garden." Some were crossed. He put the list back and closed the drawer. Later, he mentioned to his partner that he was thinking about building a birdhouse. His partner said that sounded nice and asked if he'd done it before. Chris said no, but it was on a list he'd seen. His partner shrugged, and they went back to their tasks.
text_zh: 克里斯在工具抽屉里找螺丝刀时，发现了一份待办事项清单。上面有“建一个鸟舍”和“种一个花园”等项目。有些被划掉了。他把清单放回去，关上了抽屉。后来，他告诉他的伴侣他正在考虑建一个鸟舍。他的伴侣说听起来不错，并问他以前是否做过。克里斯说没有，但这是他在一份清单上看到的。他的伴侣耸了耸肩，然后他们继续做自己的事情。

topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text_en: Nina was cleaning the living room when she found a piece of paper under the couch. It was a list of dreams, like "travel to Italy" and "learn to play chess." Some were checked. She put the paper on the coffee table. Later, she asked her partner if they'd ever wanted to go to Italy. He said yes, it was on his list. Nina said she'd found a list under the couch. He said he'd been looking for it. She handed it to him, and he put it in his pocket.
text_zh: 尼娜在打扫客厅时，在沙发下发现了一张纸。那是一份梦想清单，比如“去意大利旅行”和“学下棋”。有些打了勾。她把纸放在咖啡桌上。后来，她问她的伴侣是否曾经想去意大利。他说是的，那在他的清单上。尼娜说她在沙发下发现了一份清单。他说他一直在找它。她把它递给他，他放进了口袋里。

topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text_en: Alex was looking through the junk drawer for a flashlight when he found a list. It was a list of things to do, like "see the ocean" and "learn to cook a steak." Some were crossed. He put the list back and closed the drawer. Later, he asked his partner if they'd ever seen the ocean. She said no, but it was on her list. Alex said he'd found a list in the drawer. She said it was hers and she'd forgotten it. He said he'd put it back, and they continued looking for the flashlight.
text_zh: 亚历克斯在杂物抽屉里找手电筒时，发现了一份清单。那是一份待办事项清单，比如“看海”和“学会做牛排”。有些被划掉了。他把清单放回去，关上了抽屉。后来，他问他的伴侣是否见过大海。她说没有，但那是她的清单上的。亚历克斯说他在抽屉里发现了一份清单。她说那是她的，她忘了。他说他把它放回去了，然后他们继续找手电筒。

topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text_en: While unpacking boxes in the new apartment, Carlos came across a worn piece of paper tucked between some old books. It was his partner's bucket list, with a mix of completed and pending items. Some of the completed ones were things they had done together, like hiking a mountain trail and trying a new cuisine. Others were from before their time, like learning to juggle and visiting a specific museum. He read the list carefully and then placed it in the box with the books. Later, he asked his partner about the museum, and she told him about the exhibits she had seen there.
text_zh: 在新公寓里拆箱时，卡洛斯在一堆旧书之间发现了一张破旧的纸。那是他伴侣的遗愿清单，上面有已完成和未完成的项目。有些已完成的是他们一起做过的事情，比如徒步登山小径和尝试新菜系。其他的则是他们在一起之前的事情，比如学杂耍和参观某个特定的博物馆。他仔细读了清单，然后把它放回装有书的盒子里。后来，他问他的伴侣关于那个博物馆的事，她给他讲了她在那里看过的展品。

topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text_en: Jake was cleaning out the car when he found a list under the seat. It had items like "go to a concert" and "ride a horse." Some were crossed off. He put the list in the glove compartment. Later, he asked his partner if they'd ever been to a concert together. She said yes, a few years ago. Jake said he'd found a list in the car. She said it was hers and she'd lost it. He said he'd put it in the glove box, and they went back to cleaning.
text_zh: 杰克在清理汽车时，在座位下发现了一份清单。上面有“去听音乐会”和“骑马”等项目。有些被划掉了。他把清单放在手套箱里。后来，他问他的伴侣他们是否一起听过音乐会。她说是的，几年前。杰克说他在车里发现了一份清单。她说那是她的，她弄丢了。他说他把它放在手套箱里了，然后他们继续清理。

topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text_en: Olivia was organizing the pantry when she found a list taped to the inside of the door. It was a list of things to do, like "make jam" and "plant a rose bush." Some were checked. She left it there and continued organizing. Later, she asked her partner if they'd ever made jam. He said no, but it was on a list he'd made. Olivia said she'd seen the list in the pantry. He said he'd put it there a long time ago. She shrugged and went back to the pantry.
text_zh: 奥利维亚在整理食品储藏室时，发现门内侧贴着一份清单。那是一份待办事项清单，比如“做果酱”和“种一丛玫瑰”。有些打了勾。她把它留在那里，继续整理。后来，她问她的伴侣是否做过果酱。他说没有，但那是他列的一份清单上的。奥利维亚说她在储藏室里看到了那份清单。他说那是他很久以前放在那里的。她耸了耸肩，回到储藏室。

topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text_en: Max was cleaning the garage when he found a list in a box of old papers. It was a list of things to do, like "learn to sail" and "go on a picnic." Some were crossed. He put the list back in the box and closed it. Later, he asked his partner if they'd ever been sailing. She said no, but she'd like to. Max said he'd seen a list in the garage. She said it was probably his. He said maybe, and they went back to cleaning the garage.
text_zh: 马克斯在清理车库时，在一盒旧文件中发现了一份清单。那是一份待办事项清单，比如“学帆船”和“去野餐”。有些被划掉了。他把清单放回盒子里，合上了。后来，他问他的伴侣是否曾经航行过。她说没有，但她想去。马克斯说他在车库里看到了一份清单。她说那可能是他的。他说也许吧，然后他们继续清理车库。

topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text_en: Maya found the list tucked inside an old cookbook on the top shelf. It was written in Leo's handwriting, a series of items he'd hoped to do someday. She read through them slowly, noting the ones he'd already mentioned over the years and a few she'd never heard of. She set the paper back where she found it and continued unpacking the box. Later, when Leo came home, she didn't mention it. She simply asked if he'd ever wanted to try making pasta from scratch, and he laughed, saying he'd thought about it once.
text_zh: 玛雅在顶层架子上的旧食谱书里发现了那份清单。那是利奥的笔迹，一系列他希望有一天能做的事情。她慢慢地读了一遍，注意到那些他多年来已经提到过的，以及一些她从未听说过的。她把纸放回原处，继续拆箱。后来，利奥回家时，她没有提起这件事。她只是问他是否曾经想尝试从头开始做意大利面，他笑了，说他曾经想过一次。

topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text_en: Lena had been meaning to plant tomatoes behind the garage, but the soil there stayed soggy after every rain. When her neighbor Owen knocked and pointed to the strip of sunny lawn beside her fence, she listened as he explained his vegetable plot had become too shaded by a new tree. He offered to build a small raised bed and keep it tidy. Lena agreed, noting that she wouldn’t have to mow that narrow section anymore. Over the next few days, he hauled in boards and soil, and she watched from the kitchen window while he worked. The finished bed looked neat, with young seedlings in even rows.
text_zh: 莉娜一直想在车库后面种西红柿，但每次雨后那里的土壤都湿漉漉的。当邻居欧文敲门，指着她篱笆旁那片阳光充足的草坪时，她听他解释说他的菜地因为一棵新树而变得过于阴凉。他提出要建一个小型高架苗床并保持整洁。莉娜同意了，并指出她再也不用修剪那狭窄的一段了。接下来的几天里，他运来了木板和土壤，她则从厨房窗户看着他干活。完工的苗床看起来很整洁，幼苗成排地种着。

topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text_en: Marta’s backyard had a wide, unused corner that caught the afternoon light. Her neighbor, Priya, came over one Saturday with a sketch on a napkin, proposing a communal herb garden. Marta didn’t use that part of the yard, so she said yes. Priya brought in a few bags of compost and a bag of seeds. They spent part of the morning turning the soil together, then Priya planted basil and rosemary while Marta watered the rest of the lawn. When they finished, Priya said she’d keep an eye on it. Marta nodded and went inside to start lunch.
text_zh: 玛尔塔的后院有一个宽阔的闲置角落，下午的阳光正好照在那里。她的邻居普里亚在一个周六带着一张画在餐巾纸上的草图过来，提议建一个公共香草园。玛尔塔不用院子的那一部分，所以她同意了。普里亚带来了几袋堆肥和一袋种子。她们一起花了一上午的部分时间翻土，然后普里亚种了罗勒和迷迭香，而玛尔塔则给草坪的其余部分浇水。完成后，普里亚说她会照看它。玛尔塔点了点头，进屋开始做午饭。

topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text_en: When the man next door asked if he could plant a row of sunflowers along the fence line, Tom thought about the way the lawn there always got patchy in summer. He told him to go ahead. The neighbor showed up with a shovel and a handful of seeds, and Tom helped him clear the weeds from a narrow strip. They worked quietly, occasionally commenting on the weather. When the seeds were in, the neighbor said he’d water them from his side. Tom agreed, and that was that. He went back to trimming the hedge on the other side.
text_zh: 当隔壁的男人问他能否沿着篱笆线种一排向日葵时，汤姆想到那里的草坪夏天总是变得斑驳。他告诉他尽管种。邻居带着一把铲子和一把种子来了，汤姆帮他清理了一条狭窄地带上的杂草。他们安静地工作，偶尔评论一下天气。种子种下后，邻居说他会从他那边浇水。汤姆同意了，就这样。他回去修剪另一边的树篱。

topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text_en: Rachel’s side yard was mostly gravel and a few scraggly bushes. Her neighbor, an older man named Ed, asked if he could put in a small vegetable patch there, since his own yard was too shady. Rachel didn’t mind; she rarely used that part of the property. She gave him permission, and Ed spent the next afternoon building a low wooden frame and filling it with soil. Rachel came out to check on him once, and he showed her where he planned to put carrots and beans. She nodded, then went back inside to finish her book.
text_zh: 瑞秋的侧院大多是砾石和几丛稀疏的灌木。她的邻居，一位名叫埃德的老人，问她能否在那里建一个小菜园，因为他自己的院子太阴了。瑞秋不介意；她很少使用那部分房产。她给了他许可，埃德在接下来的一个下午建了一个低矮的木框并填满了土壤。瑞秋出来看了他一次，他给她看了他打算种胡萝卜和豆子的地方。她点了点头，然后回去读完她的书。

topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text_en: Nina’s backyard had a sunny strip near the back fence that she never used. When her neighbor, a young woman named Jess, knocked and asked if she could grow vegetables there, Nina thought it over. The space would be out of her way, and Jess seemed responsible. She said yes, as long as Jess kept it neat. Jess agreed, and a few days later she arrived with bags of soil and a tray of seedlings. Nina watched from the porch as Jess worked. When Jess asked if she wanted any of the harvest, Nina said she’d think about it.
text_zh: 尼娜的后院靠近后篱笆有一条阳光充足的狭长地带，她从未使用过。当她的邻居，一位名叫杰丝的年轻女子，敲门问她能否在那里种蔬菜时，尼娜想了想。那块地方不会妨碍她，而且杰丝看起来挺负责的。她同意了，只要杰丝保持整洁。杰丝同意了，几天后她带着几袋土壤和一盘幼苗来了。尼娜在门廊上看着杰丝干活。当杰丝问她是否想要一些收成时，尼娜说她会考虑一下。

topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text_en: The neighbor’s request came while Sam was pulling weeds from the front walk. The man said his backyard was too shaded for vegetables, and he’d noticed Sam’s sunny side yard. Sam didn’t have plans for that patch of ground, so he said yes. The neighbor brought over a rototiller and turned the soil that weekend. Sam helped him lay out a few rows. They didn’t talk much, but the work got done. When the neighbor left, Sam went back to his weeding. The side yard looked different now, but it wasn’t a problem.
text_zh: 邻居的请求是在萨姆从前门走道上拔杂草时提出的。那人说他的后院太阴了，种不了蔬菜，他注意到萨姆的侧院阳光充足。萨姆对那块地没有计划，所以他同意了。那个周末邻居带来了一台旋耕机翻了土。萨姆帮他布置了几行。他们没怎么说话，但活干完了。邻居离开后，萨姆回去继续拔草。侧院现在看起来不一样了，但这不是问题。

topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text_en: When the new neighbor knocked, she asked if she could plant tomatoes along the fence line. Mara had never really used that strip of yard, so she agreed. They spent an afternoon turning the soil together, pulling out old roots and rocks. Mara brought out a pitcher of water while the neighbor marked rows with string. A few weeks later, green shoots appeared. Mara watered them when the neighbor was away at work. She found it pleasant to see the plants grow against the wooden fence, and they exchanged occasional nods through the kitchen window.
text_zh: 当新邻居敲门时，她问能否沿着篱笆线种西红柿。玛拉从未真正使用过那块狭长的院子，所以她同意了。他们花了一个下午一起翻土，拔出旧根和石头。玛拉端出一壶水，而邻居用绳子标出行距。几周后，绿芽出现了。邻居上班时，玛拉给它们浇水。她发现看着植物沿着木栅栏生长很惬意，他们偶尔通过厨房窗户点头致意。

topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text_en: When the neighbor asked about using the strip of land between their driveways, Carla wasn’t sure what he wanted to plant. He explained he’d like to grow some herbs—basil, thyme, oregano. Carla didn’t use that strip; it was mostly weeds. She said he could, as long as he kept it tidy. He came over the next day with a few pots and bags of soil. He worked for about an hour, then showed her the neat rows. Carla thanked him and went inside. The strip looked better than it had before.
text_zh: 当邻居问起使用他们车道之间的那条狭长地带时，卡拉不确定他想种什么。他解释说他想种一些香草——罗勒、百里香、牛至。卡拉不用那条地带；那里大多是杂草。她说他可以，只要他保持整洁。第二天他带着几个花盆和几袋土壤来了。他工作了大约一个小时，然后给她看了整齐的几行。卡拉感谢了他，然后进去了。那条地带看起来比以前好多了。

topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text_en: Dana’s backyard had a large patch of lawn that she never mowed regularly. Her neighbor, a man with a small child, asked if he could turn a corner of it into a vegetable garden. Dana thought about it; she didn’t have the time to maintain that part anyway. She agreed, and the neighbor brought over a few bags of soil and some seeds. He spent the afternoon planting while Dana watched from the deck. When he was done, he said he’d take care of the weeding. Dana nodded and went back to her book.
text_zh: 达娜的后院有一大片草坪，她从不定期修剪。她的邻居，一个带着小孩的男人，问她能否把院子的一角变成菜园。达娜想了想；反正她也没有时间打理那一部分。她同意了，邻居带来了几袋土壤和一些种子。他花了一个下午种植，而达娜在甲板上看着。完成后，他说他会负责除草。达娜点了点头，回到她的书上。

topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text_en: The request came from the new neighbor across the street, who had noticed that the side of Marcus’s house got a lot of sun. She asked if she could plant a small vegetable garden there. Marcus didn’t use that side of the yard, so he said yes. She came over with a few buckets and a trowel, and she worked for a couple of hours. Marcus looked out the window once and saw her patting down the soil. When she left, she waved. Marcus waved back. The side yard now had a few green shoots, but that was fine.
text_zh: 请求来自街对面的新邻居，她注意到马库斯房子的一侧阳光充足。她问能否在那里种一个小菜园。马库斯不用院子的那一侧，所以他同意了。她带着几个水桶和一把泥刀来了，工作了几个小时。马库斯从窗户往外看了一次，看到她正在拍实土壤。她离开时挥了挥手。马库斯也挥了挥手。侧院现在有了几株绿芽，但这没关系。

topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text_en: Elena’s yard was mostly lawn, but there was a sunny patch near the fence that she had never gotten around to planting. Her neighbor, an older woman, asked if she could grow some flowers and vegetables there. Elena didn’t mind, so she said yes. The neighbor brought over a few flats of seedlings and a small spade. Elena helped her plant them, and they talked about the best way to water them. When they finished, the neighbor said she’d come by every morning to check. Elena agreed and went inside to make lunch.
text_zh: 埃琳娜的院子大部分是草坪，但靠近栅栏处有一块阳光充足的地方，她一直没来得及种点什么。她的邻居，一位年长的女士，问她能否在那里种些花和蔬菜。埃琳娜不介意，就答应了。邻居带来了几盘幼苗和一把小铲子。埃琳娜帮她种下，她们还讨论了浇水的合适方法。种完后，邻居说她每天早上都会过来看看。埃琳娜同意了，然后进屋去做午饭。

topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text_en: When the man next door asked if he could use a corner of the backyard for a vegetable patch, Paul thought about the fact that he had never used that corner for anything. He told him to go ahead. The neighbor came over with a shovel and a bag of compost, and he spent the afternoon digging. Paul offered him a glass of water once. The neighbor thanked him and continued. When he was done, the corner was a neat square of dark soil. Paul didn’t mind. He went back to his own projects.
text_zh: 当隔壁的男人问他能否在后院的一个角落种菜时，保罗想到自己从未用过那个角落。他让他尽管用。邻居带着一把铲子和一袋堆肥过来，花了一下午挖地。保罗给他递了一杯水。邻居道谢后继续干活。完工后，那个角落变成了一块整齐的深色土壤。保罗并不介意，他回去忙自己的事了。

topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text_en: Leo looked out the window and saw the woman from next door standing at the edge of his lawn with a shovel. He went outside to see what she was doing. She explained that her own yard was too shaded and wondered if she could use his sunny corner for vegetables. Leo hadn't planned anything for that spot, so he told her it was fine. She thanked him and began marking a small plot. Over the following weeks, he noticed her there in the evenings, weeding and watering. He sometimes watched from the porch while finishing his coffee.
text_zh: 利奥望向窗外，看到隔壁的女人拿着铲子站在他家草坪边上。他出去看看她在做什么。她解释说自家院子太阴了，想知道能否用他这块阳光充足的角落种蔬菜。利奥没打算在那块地方种什么，就告诉她没问题。她道了谢，开始划出一小块地。接下来的几周，他注意到她傍晚在那里除草、浇水。他有时会端着咖啡在门廊上看着。

topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text_en: Priya was reading on the back porch when her neighbor appeared at the gate, holding a flat of seedlings. She asked if Priya would mind if she started a small herb garden in the unused bed near the garage. Priya had never gotten around to planting anything there, so she nodded and pointed to the spot. The neighbor knelt and began transferring the small plants into the soil. Later, Priya noticed basil and mint taking shape along the edge. She found herself checking the progress whenever she walked past, noting how the leaves had grown.
text_zh: 普里亚正在后门廊看书，邻居出现在门口，手里拿着一盘幼苗。她问普里亚是否介意她在车库旁那块未使用的花坛里种一个小香草园。普里亚一直没来得及在那里种任何东西，于是点点头，指了指那个地方。邻居跪下，开始把小苗移栽到土里。后来，普里亚注意到罗勒和薄荷沿着边缘长了出来。她发现自己每次路过时都会查看长势，留意叶子长了多少。

topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text_en: The man from across the street knocked on the door and asked about the patch of ground beside the driveway. He mentioned it stayed sunny most of the day and wondered if he could grow some peppers there. Sandra didn't use that area for anything, so she agreed. He brought over bags of compost and worked the soil on a Saturday morning. She watched from the window as he planted small starts and set up simple stakes. In the weeks after, she saw him tending the plants regularly. The green leaves spread out and the patch looked fuller than it had before.
text_zh: 街对面的男人敲门，问起车道旁边那块地。他提到那里大部分时间阳光充足，想知道能否在那里种些辣椒。桑德拉不用那块地方，就同意了。周六早上，他带来几袋堆肥，翻了土。她从窗户看着他种下小苗，搭起简单的支架。之后的几周，她看到他定期照料那些植物。绿叶舒展开来，那块地看起来比以前更丰茂了。

topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text_en: The man next door knocked while Leo was washing his car. He asked if he could plant some tomatoes in the sunny spot near the fence. Leo didn’t use that spot, so he said sure. The neighbor brought over a few seedlings and a roll of fencing. Leo helped him set up a small trellis. They planted the tomatoes and watered them. The neighbor said he’d come by to check on them. Leo nodded and went back to washing. The spot now had a few plants, but it wasn’t a big change.
text_zh: 利奥正在洗车时，隔壁的男人敲门。他问能否在栅栏旁阳光充足的地方种些西红柿。利奥不用那块地方，就说当然可以。邻居带来几棵幼苗和一卷围栏。利奥帮他搭了一个小棚架。他们种下西红柿并浇了水。邻居说他以后会过来照看。利奥点点头，回去继续洗车。那块地方现在有几棵植物，但变化不大。

topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text_en: The neighbor, a young woman, asked if she could grow some flowers and vegetables in the unused patch behind the garage. Hannah said yes, since she had never gotten around to doing anything with that area. The neighbor brought over a few bags of soil and a handful of seeds. Hannah helped her clear the weeds. They planted marigolds and beans. The neighbor said she’d take care of watering. Hannah nodded and went back to her own gardening. The patch looked better than it had before, with the soil turned and seeds in place.
text_zh: 邻居，一位年轻女士，问她能否在车库后面那块未使用的空地上种些花和蔬菜。汉娜答应了，因为她一直没来得及打理那块地方。邻居带来几袋土和一把种子。汉娜帮她清了杂草。她们种了万寿菊和豆子。邻居说她会负责浇水。汉娜点点头，回去继续自己的园艺活。那块地翻过土、播了种，看起来比以前好了。

topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text_en: When the neighbor asked about using the strip of lawn next to the driveway, Victor thought it over. He didn’t use that strip for anything, so he agreed. The neighbor came over with a shovel and a few bags of compost. Victor helped him turn the soil. They planted a few rows of carrots and radishes. The neighbor said he’d weed and water. Victor nodded and went inside. The strip now had small green sprouts, but Victor didn’t pay much attention to it. He had his own work to do.
text_zh: 当邻居问起能否使用车道旁那条草坪时，维克多想了想。他不用那条草坪，就同意了。邻居带着一把铲子和几袋堆肥过来。维克多帮他翻了土。他们种了几排胡萝卜和小萝卜。邻居说他会除草和浇水。维克多点点头，进了屋。那条草坪上现在冒出了小绿芽，但维克多没太在意。他有自己的事要做。

topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text_en: The request came from the neighbor who lived behind her, whose yard was mostly concrete. She asked if she could use a patch of grass near the fence to grow some herbs. Julia didn’t mind, so she said yes. The neighbor brought over a few pots and a bag of soil. Julia helped her set them up and plant basil and chives. The neighbor said she’d come by to water them. Julia nodded and went back to her reading. The pots sat in a neat row along the fence, and Julia didn’t have to do anything else.
text_zh: 请求来自住在朱莉娅后面的邻居，她的院子大部分是水泥地。她问能否用栅栏旁的一小块草地种些香草。朱莉娅不介意，就答应了。邻居带来几个花盆和一袋土。朱莉娅帮她摆好花盆，种上罗勒和细香葱。邻居说她会过来浇水。朱莉娅点点头，回去继续看书。花盆沿着栅栏排成整齐的一排，朱莉娅不用再做任何事。

topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text_en: The neighbor, a middle-aged man, asked if he could plant a small vegetable garden in the far corner of the yard. Alice didn’t use that corner, so she agreed. He came over with a few tools and a bag of seeds. Alice watched from the kitchen window as he worked. He spent about an hour digging and planting. When he was done, he came to the door to say he’d water it every evening. Alice thanked him and went back to her chores. The corner now had a neat patch of soil, but it didn’t affect her day.
text_zh: 邻居，一位中年男子，问能否在院子最远的角落种一个小菜园。爱丽丝不用那个角落，就同意了。他带着几件工具和一袋种子过来。爱丽丝从厨房窗户看着他干活。他花了大约一个小时挖地、播种。干完后，他来到门口说他会每天晚上浇水。爱丽丝道了谢，回去继续做家务。那个角落现在有了一块整齐的土壤，但并没有影响她的一天。

topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text_en: Marta found the notice taped to the lobby door when she came back from her shift. The building was going condo, and current tenants could buy their units at a discount. She read it twice, then folded it into her pocket. Inside her apartment, she looked around the living room—the worn couch, the bookshelf she’d assembled last year. She sat down and started a list: what she might save, what she might need to sell. The phone rang; her sister asked about weekend plans. Marta said she’d call back later.
text_zh: 玛尔塔下班回来时，发现通知贴在大厅门上。大楼要改成共管公寓，现有租户可以打折购买自己的单元。她读了两遍，然后把它折好放进口袋。回到公寓里，她环顾客厅——破旧的沙发，去年她亲手组装的书架。她坐下来，开始列清单：她可能省下什么，可能需要卖掉什么。电话响了；她姐姐问周末计划。玛尔塔说她会晚点回电话。

topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text_en: Maya read the notice taped to the lobby door while waiting for the elevator. The building was converting to condominiums, and residents could choose to buy their units or move out by the end of the season. She folded the paper and slipped it into her coat pocket. That evening, she mentioned it to her neighbor in the laundry room. They compared what they had heard from other tenants, though neither had all the details yet. Maya continued sorting her clothes, adding the notice to the pile of papers on her desk later that night.
text_zh: 玛雅等电梯时，读了大厅门上贴的通知。大楼要改成共管公寓，居民可以选择购买自己的单元，或者在本季度末前搬走。她把纸折好，塞进外套口袋。那天晚上，她在洗衣房跟邻居提起了这件事。他们比较了从其他租户那里听到的消息，尽管两人都还没有掌握全部细节。玛雅继续整理衣服，当晚晚些时候把通知加到了桌上的文件堆里。

topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text_en: When Daniel got home from work, he found a letter under his door from the property management company. The building was going condo, and current renters would have the first option to purchase. He read the letter once, then placed it on the kitchen counter beside his keys. Later, he called his brother to mention it, but the conversation drifted to other topics. He kept the letter in sight for the next few days, occasionally glancing at it while making coffee or paying bills, though he had not yet decided what to do.
text_zh: 丹尼尔下班回家，发现门底下有一封物业管理公司的信。大楼要改成共管公寓，现有租户有优先购买权。他读了一遍信，然后把它放在厨房台面上，旁边是他的钥匙。后来，他打电话给哥哥提了这件事，但话题转到了别处。接下来的几天，他一直把信放在显眼的地方，煮咖啡或付账单时偶尔瞥一眼，尽管他还没有决定怎么办。

topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text_en: Priya noticed the flyer in the hallway near the mailboxes. The owners were converting the apartments to condos, and tenants had a period to decide whether to buy. She took a photo of the flyer with her phone so she would not lose the information. That evening, she talked with a coworker who lived in a similar building that had gone through the same process. They discussed the general steps involved, though Priya knew her own situation might differ. She saved the photo in an album and continued her usual routine.
text_zh: 普里亚注意到邮箱附近走廊里的传单。业主们要把公寓改成共管公寓，租户有一段时间来决定是否购买。她用手机拍了传单的照片，以免丢失信息。那天晚上，她和一位同事聊了聊，这位同事住在一栋经历过同样过程的类似大楼里。他们讨论了涉及的一般步骤，尽管普里亚知道自己的情况可能不同。她把照片存进相册，继续她的日常作息。

topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text_en: Maya picked up the letter from the lobby table and read it standing by the elevator. The building was going condo, and current tenants would get first option to buy at a set price. She folded the paper and tucked it into her bag as the doors opened. That evening she mentioned it to her roommate while they made dinner. They talked about whether the price seemed fair and what it might mean for rent. Maya put it on the counter with the other mail, planning to look more closely at the paperwork over the weekend.
text_zh: 玛雅从大厅桌上拿起信，站在电梯旁读了起来。大楼要改成共管公寓，现有租户将获得按设定价格优先购买的权利。她把纸折好，在电梯门打开时塞进包里。那天晚上，她和室友一起做晚饭时提起了这件事。他们讨论了价格是否看起来公平，以及这对租金可能意味着什么。玛雅把它和其他邮件一起放在台面上，打算周末更仔细地看看那些文件。

topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text_en: The notice was posted in the elevator, right next to the monthly cleaning schedule. It said the owners had filed for conversion, and residents would receive details by mail. Carlos read it on his way down to the parking garage. He didn’t say anything to the other person in the elevator. That evening, he mentioned it to his wife, who said, “We should start looking at what apartments cost around here.” Carlos nodded, then turned on the news. A few days later, they asked the property manager about the timeline.
text_zh: 通知贴在电梯里，就在每月清洁时间表旁边。上面说业主们已经提交了改建申请，居民们会通过邮件收到详细信息。卡洛斯在去地下停车场的路上读到了它。他没有跟电梯里的另一个人说什么。那天晚上，他跟妻子提起了这件事，妻子说：“我们应该开始看看这附近的公寓价格。”卡洛斯点点头，然后打开了新闻。几天后，他们向物业经理询问了时间安排。

topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text_en: Marcus came across the notice while checking his mailbox. The building was being converted to condominiums, and residents would have the chance to buy their apartments. He read the details in the elevator, then folded the paper and put it in his bag. That weekend, he mentioned it to a friend during a walk in the park. They talked about how such conversions sometimes worked in other buildings. Marcus nodded and changed the subject to the weather. He kept the notice in his bag for reference, though he did not revisit it right away.
text_zh: 马库斯在查看邮箱时看到了通知。大楼要改成共管公寓，居民们将有机会购买自己的公寓。他在电梯里读了细节，然后把纸折好放进包里。那个周末，他在公园散步时跟一位朋友提起了这件事。他们聊了聊这种改建在其他大楼里有时是如何运作的。马库斯点点头，把话题转到了天气上。他把通知放在包里以备参考，尽管他没有马上再看。

topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text_en: Sofia heard about the condo conversion from the super while he fixed her kitchen faucet. He said the owners had filed the paperwork and tenants would receive official letters soon. She listened and asked a question about the timeline, which he answered briefly. After he left, she finished wiping the counter and went back to reading a novel. The next day, a letter did arrive, confirming what he had said. She set it on the table with her other mail, planning to look at it more closely over the weekend.
text_zh: 索菲亚是从管理员那里听说共管公寓改建的事的，当时他正在修她厨房的水龙头。他说业主们已经提交了文件，租户们很快就会收到正式信函。她听着，问了一个关于时间安排的问题，他简短地回答了。他走后，她擦完台面，回去继续读一本小说。第二天，一封信确实到了，证实了他所说的话。她把它和其他邮件一起放在桌上，打算周末更仔细地看看。

topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text_en: The notice came tucked under the door while Luis was getting ready for work. He read it quickly, noting that the owners had filed to convert the building to condominiums. He set it aside and finished his coffee, then stopped by the front desk to ask the super if he knew anything. The super shrugged, saying it had been talked about for a while. Luis nodded and headed out. Later, he left the letter on the kitchen table, thinking he might call a friend who had gone through something similar with her building last year.
text_zh: 路易斯正准备上班时，通知从门底下塞了进来。他快速读了一遍，注意到业主们已经提交了将大楼改建为共管公寓的申请。他把它放在一边，喝完咖啡，然后去前台问管理员是否知道什么。管理员耸耸肩，说这事已经谈了一段时间了。路易斯点点头，然后出门了。后来，他把信留在厨房桌上，想着也许可以给一位朋友打电话，她去年的大楼也经历过类似的事情。

topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text_en: Priya found the flyer in her mailbox when she got home from the store. It announced the building's conversion to condominiums and included details about a tenants' meeting scheduled for the following week. She put it on the fridge and unpacked her groceries. When her partner came in, she handed him the paper. They both read it, and he said he'd try to make the meeting if he could. Priya put the kettle on and mentioned that a coworker had bought her apartment in a similar situation a few years back.
text_zh: 普里亚从商店回家时，在邮箱里发现了传单。它宣布大楼将改建为共管公寓，并包含了下周安排租户会议的具体信息。她把它放在冰箱上，然后整理买来的杂货。她的伴侣进来时，她把纸递给他。他们俩都读了，他说如果可能的话，他会尽量参加会议。普里亚烧上水，提到一位同事几年前在类似情况下买了她的公寓。

topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text_en: The notice was in the common area, next to the mailboxes. It had a bold heading: “Notice of Conversion to Condominium Ownership.” Rachel read it as she collected her mail. She took a copy and put it in her bag. At home, she sat at the kitchen table and read it thoroughly. She underlined the date of the information session. Then she called her sister, who was a realtor, and asked what she thought about condo conversions. They talked for a while about market trends. After hanging up, Rachel made a list of questions to ask at the meeting.
text_zh: 通知贴在公共区域，邮箱旁边。标题醒目：“关于转换为公寓所有权制的通知”。瑞秋取邮件时看到了。她拿了一份放进包里。回到家，她坐在厨房桌边仔细阅读。她划出了信息说明会的日期。然后她给当房产经纪人的姐姐打了电话，询问她对公寓转换的看法。她们聊了一会儿市场趋势。挂断电话后，瑞秋列了一份要在会上提问的清单。

topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text_en: The building manager posted a letter on each door. It said the owners were planning to convert the building to condos and tenants would have the right to buy. Sam read his copy, then put it on the entryway table. He went to the gym, and when he came back, he saw the letter again. He picked it up and looked at the contact information. He decided to wait until the next week’s meeting to get more details. He put the letter back down and went to make a sandwich.
text_zh: 楼管在每户门上贴了一封信。信上说业主正计划把大楼改成公寓，租户有权购买。山姆读了信，把它放在门厅桌上。他去健身房，回来后，又看到了那封信。他拿起来，看了看联系方式。他决定等到下周的会议再了解更多细节。他把信放回去，去做三明治了。

topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text_en: Jason saw the notice taped to the main entrance door one morning. The building was being converted, and residents would have a chance to purchase their units. He pulled it off and brought it inside, reading it again by the window. He thought about his savings and how long he'd planned to stay. That afternoon he ran into a neighbor in the hall who had also read it, and they stood talking for a few minutes about what it might mean. Jason later left the notice on his desk, figuring he'd deal with it when he had more time.
text_zh: 一天早上，杰森看到主入口门上贴着通知。大楼正在改造成公寓，住户有机会购买自己的单元。他把它撕下来带进去，在窗边又读了一遍。他想着自己的积蓄，以及他原本打算住多久。那天下午，他在走廊里碰到一个也读过通知的邻居，他们站着聊了几分钟，讨论这可能意味着什么。杰森后来把通知放在桌上，想着等有更多时间再处理。

topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text_en: The notice was posted on the elevator door, and a copy was also slid under his door. Kevin read the elevator one, then the one under his door. They were the same. He put the copy on the desk. That weekend, he was going through his files and found the notice again. He set it aside. He called his father to ask if he had any advice about buying a condo. His father said it depended on the price. Kevin said he didn’t know the price yet. They talked about other things.
text_zh: 通知贴在电梯门上，门缝下也塞了一份。凯文读了电梯里的那份，又读了门下的那份。内容一样。他把那份放在桌子上。那个周末，他在整理文件时又发现了通知。他把它搁在一边。他打电话给父亲，问他对买公寓有没有什么建议。父亲说那要看价格。凯文说他还不知道价格。他们聊了些别的事。

topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text_en: Aisha was sorting through her mail when she found the envelope from the property company. Inside was a notice about the building's conversion to condominiums, with details about the purchase option for current renters. She read it at the kitchen table, then put it back in the envelope. That night, she mentioned it to a neighbor they ran into in the stairwell. They wondered how many people might decide to stay. Aisha shrugged and said she would see. She kept the envelope in a stack of papers and went to bed at her usual time.
text_zh: 艾莎在整理邮件时发现了物业公司寄来的信封。里面是关于大楼转换为公寓的通知，详细说明了现有租户的购买选项。她在厨房桌边读了，然后放回信封。那晚，她在楼梯间遇到一位邻居，提起了这件事。他们琢磨着会有多少人决定留下来。艾莎耸耸肩说，到时候看吧。她把信封放在一叠文件里，按往常时间上床睡觉了。

topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text_en: The property manager posted a notice in the hallway about the building going condo. It said residents would receive a packet with more information. Omar read it on his way to the stairwell. He didn’t think much about it until the packet arrived a few days later. It included a letter, a FAQ sheet, and a form to express interest. He put the packet on the kitchen table. That evening, he filled out the form with his name and unit number, but left the decision section blank. He planned to ask about the price at the meeting.
text_zh: 物业经理在走廊里贴了关于大楼转公寓的通知。通知说住户会收到一份包含更多信息的资料包。奥马尔去楼梯间的路上看到了。他没太在意，直到几天后资料包到了。里面有封信、一份常见问题解答，还有一份表达意向的表。他把资料包放在厨房桌上。当晚，他填了姓名和单元号，但意向部分留空。他打算在会上询问价格。

topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text_en: When she got home from a late shift, Grace saw a notice taped to the inside of her door. It said the building was being converted to condos and tenants could buy their units. She read it, then peeled it off and took it inside. She put it on the coffee table. The next morning, she looked at it again. She called the number on the notice and asked for more information. The person on the phone said a packet would be sent out. Grace thanked them and hung up. She then left for work.
text_zh: 格蕾丝下晚班回到家，看到门内侧贴着一张通知。通知说大楼正在改造成公寓，租户可以购买自己的单元。她读了，然后撕下来拿进屋，放在茶几上。第二天早上，她又看了看。她拨了通知上的号码，要求更多信息。电话里的人说会寄一份资料包。格蕾丝道了谢，挂了电话，然后上班去了。

topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text_en: The notice was in the lobby, near the front desk. It had the building’s logo and a headline about the conversion to condominiums. Rosa read it while waiting for the elevator. She took a photo with her phone. Later, she showed it to her neighbor in the laundry room. The neighbor said, “I heard they’re going to give us first dibs.” Rosa said, “That’s what the notice says.” They both went back to their laundry. When Rosa got back to her apartment, she saved the photo in a folder on her phone.
text_zh: 通知在大堂，前台附近。上面有楼的标志和关于改造成公寓的标题。萝莎等电梯时读了。她拿手机拍了照。后来，她在洗衣房给邻居看了。邻居说：“听说他们会给我们优先购买权。”萝莎说：“通知上是这么说的。”两人又继续洗衣服。萝莎回到公寓后，把照片存到了手机的一个文件夹里。

topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text_en: Ben was checking his mailbox when he saw a flyer about the building’s condo conversion. He took it out and read it. It said there would be a meeting for residents next month. He put the flyer in his bag. At home, he put it on the desk. He didn’t mention it to his roommate, who was out. Later that week, the roommate saw the flyer and asked, “Are we going to buy?” Ben said, “I don’t know. We need to see the price.” The roommate nodded. They left the flyer on the desk.
text_zh: 本在查邮箱时看到一张关于楼房转公寓的传单。他拿出来读了。上面说下个月会为住户开一个会。他把传单放进包里。回到家，放在桌上。他没跟不在家的室友提。那周晚些时候，室友看到传单，问：“我们要买吗？”本说：“我不知道。我们得看价格。”室友点点头。他们把传单留在桌上。

topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text_en: The notice was pinned to the community board, and also a copy was slipped under her door. It was a formal letter about the conversion to condos. Mia read the one under her door, then compared it to the one on the board. They were the same. She went back to her apartment and placed the letter on the bookshelf. Later, she was talking to a friend on the phone and mentioned the notice. The friend said, “That could be a good opportunity.” Mia said, “Maybe.” They talked about other things. After the call, she looked up the building’s management company online.
text_zh: 通知钉在社区公告板上，门缝下也塞了一份。是一封关于转公寓的正式信。米娅读了门下那份，又跟公告板上的对比了一下。一样。她回到公寓，把信放在书架上。后来，她跟朋友打电话时提到了通知。朋友说：“那可能是个好机会。”米娅说：“也许吧。”他们聊了些别的事。挂了电话，她上网查了楼的管理公司。
